title: EU calls emergency meeting to discuss Ceuta migrant crossings
english: The European Union is convening an emergency meeting to address the recent surge of thousands of migrants crossing into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco. While most migrants have since returned, the event has sparked significant political tension, with several EU member states questioning Spain's border management and calling for stronger external controls. Spanish officials have defended their actions, arguing that their borders are secure and criticizing other nations for using the situation to stir political polarization.

title: Police say 13 killed as small plane viewing Nazca Lines in Peru crashes
english: A small sightseeing plane crashed in southern Peru, resulting in the deaths of all 13 people on board. The flight was carrying tourists to view the historic Nazca Lines, a famous UNESCO World Heritage site known for its ancient ground carvings. The aircraft caught fire immediately upon impact, and authorities are currently investigating the cause of the fatal accident.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ፔሩ የቱሪስት አውሮፕላን ተከስክሶ በውስጡ የነበሩ 13 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አውሮፕላኑ ታዋቂውን የናዝካ መስመሮች (Nazca Lines) ለመጎብኘት በረራ ላይ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ከተከሰከሰ በኋላ በአደጋው ሁሉም ተሳፋሪዎችና የአውሮፕላኑ አብራሪዎች ሞተዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው የተከሰተውን የእሳት ቃጠሎ ተከትሎ የደረሰውን አሳዛኝ ክስተት መንስኤ እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri xiqqoon tuuristoota fe’ee ture kibba Peruutti kufuusaa, namoonni 13 battalatti lubbuun darbe. Xiyyaarichi bakka seena-qabeessa kan ta’e 'Nazca Lines' ilaaluuf erga ka’ee booda dha, erga kufuusaa boodas ibiddaan guutamee lubbuun nama tokkoo illee hin oolle. Aangoonni mootummaa sababa balaa kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Fighting breaks out in western Tigray as Ethiopia and TPLF trade blame
english: Violent clashes have erupted in western Tigray, marking a major violation of the 2022 peace agreement between the Ethiopian federal government and Tigrayan forces. Both sides have traded accusations over who initiated the fighting near Sheraro, which follows months of rising tensions and failed negotiations. Experts warn this is the most significant threat to peace since the Pretoria deal, as both parties claim the other is responsible for the instability.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ፌዴራላዊ መንግሥት እና በትግራይ ኃይሎች መካከል የተደረሰው የሰላም ስምምነት በመጣስ በምዕራብ ትግራይ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ግጭት ተቀስቅሷል። በሸራሮ አቅራቢያ በተካሄደው ውጊያ ላይ ሁለቱም ወገኖች የጥቃቱ መነሻ ሌላኛው ወገን ነው በሚል እርስ በርስ እየተወነጃጀሉ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ክስተት ከወራት በፊት ሲባባስ የቆየውን ውጥረት ተከትሎ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተፈረመውን የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት ለአደጋ የጋለጠ ትልቅ ስጋት መሆኑን ታዛቢዎች ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa federaalaafi humnoota Tigraay gidduutti walii galteen nagaa bara 2022 irra darbuun, lixaa Tigraay keessatti walitti bu’iinsi cimaan uumameera. Gamachuun kunneen naannoo Sharaarootti kan jalqabaman yoo ta’u, gama lamaanuu lola kana eenyutu akka jalqabe wal himataa jiru. Walitti bu’iinsi kun ji’oota hedduuf dhiphinaafi walitti bu’iinsa siyaasaa ture hordofuun kan dhufe yoo ta’u, ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, kun walii galtee nagaa Preetooriyaa booda balaa nagaa biyyattii irratti xuuxu hunda caaluudha.

title: Tourist plane crashes in Peru, killing 13
english: A small tourist plane crashed near the Nazca Lines in Peru on Saturday, resulting in the deaths of all 13 people on board. The flight included 11 passengers and two pilots who were touring the famous UNESCO World Heritage site. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, as the specific cause of the accident and the identities of those involved remain unknown.

oromo: Naannoo biyya Peru kan argamu bakka seena-qabeessa 'Nazca Lines' jedhamutti xiyyaaraan xiqqa tokko kan krashe yoo ta'u, namoonni 13 keessa turan hundi du'aniiru. Xiyyaarrichi namoota 11 fi qondaaltota 2 fe'ee bakka kana daawwachaa ture. Aangeyyoonni sababa balaa kanaa fi eenyummaa namoota du'anii qorachaa jiru.

title: Greece battles raging wildfires as flames appear to ease in France
english: Greece is currently facing severe wildfires fueled by high winds, leading to widespread evacuations and the destruction of homes near Athens. Emergency crews are working extensively to manage the growing disaster as authorities warn of continued extreme risks. Meanwhile, officials in France report that their own major forest fires have finally been brought under control following successful containment efforts.

title: Record-breaking climber Nirmal Purja among those killed in avalanche
english: Renowned Nepalese mountaineer Nirmal Purja, famous for his record-breaking climbs featured in a Netflix documentary, has died in an avalanche. The tragedy occurred during his expedition at Broad Peak in Pakistan. Rescue teams have already recovered three bodies from the site.
amharic: በኔትፍሊክስ ዘጋቢ ፊልም የታወቁት እና የዓለማችንን ከፍተኛ ተራሮች በመውጣት ሪከርድ የሰበሩት የኔፓላዊው ተራራ ተወጣጣ ኒርማል ፑርጃ በአደጋ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በፓኪስታን በሚገኘው ብሮድ ፒክ ተራራ ላይ በደረሰ የበረዶ ናዳ ምክንያት ነው አደጋው የተከሰተው። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች እስካሁን የሶስት ሰዎችን አስከሬን ማግኘታቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Namni gaara bahuun beekamu fi dokumantarii Neetfliks irraa beekamtii argate Nirmal Purja, balaa gaara irraa gadi dhufte kanaan lubbuun isaa darbeera. Balaan kun kan isa mudate yeroo inni biyya Paakistaanitti gaara 'Broad Peak' bahuuf yaalii gochaa turetti. Gareen fayyisuu namoota sadanii reeffa erga arganii booda du'a isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Trump denounces Justice Department decision to drop Reflecting Pool charges
english: President Donald Trump has publicly criticized the Department of Justice for dropping vandalism charges against former athlete David Hearn regarding damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. While prosecutor Jeanine Pirro concluded the damage was due to a botched installation rather than intentional destruction, Trump insists the incident was an act of vandalism. This controversy highlights ongoing tensions surrounding the pool's renovation, which has faced scrutiny due to the president's decision to bypass competitive bidding for the project.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በሊንከን ሜሞሪያል የመዋኛ ገንዳ ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት በማስመልከት በቀድሞ አትሌት ዳዊት ሄርን ላይ መስርቶት የነበረውን ክስ መዝጋቱን ተችተዋል። አቃቤ ህጉ ጉዳቱ የደረሰው በስህተት በተሰራ ግንባታ እንጂ በሆን ተብሎ በተፈጸመ ጥፋት አይደለም ብለው ቢደመድሙም፣ ትራምፕ ግን ድርጊቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ የጥፋት ወንጀል መሆኑን አጥብቀው ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ክስተት የመዋኛ ገንዳውን እድሳት ለማከናወን በጨረታ ሂደት ውስጥ የተመረጠው ኩባንያ አሰራር ላይ እየተነሳ ያለውን ተቃውሞ ይበልጥ ጎላ አድርጎ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaanad Tiraamp, ministeerri haqaa namicha ispoorteessaa duraanii Deeviid Heern jedhamu irratti, lafa 'Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool' miidhe jedhamee himannaa baname haquu isaa mormaniiru. Abbaan alangaa Jiniin Piirroo miidhaan kun kan ga'e sababa hojii ijaarsaa sirrii hin taaneen malee badii raawwatameen miti jedhanii himannicha yoo gadi dhiisanis, Tiraamp garuu inni kun badii raawwatame dha jechuun falmaniiru. Dhimmi kun ijaarsa lafa kanaa ilaalchisee adeemsa moorummaa malee kaffaltii miliyoonaan lakkaawwamu kenname irratti mormii jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Palestinian children among those detained in Israeli West Bank raids
english: Israeli forces recently detained seven Palestinians, including two teenagers, during a series of overnight military raids across various locations in the occupied West Bank. Simultaneously, there has been a rise in settler violence, highlighted by an attack on a farming couple and the establishment of multiple illegal outposts. These incidents are part of a broader, ongoing trend of daily military operations and settlement expansion affecting communities throughout the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት ተከታታይ ወረራ ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በአንጻሩ የአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ገበሬዎች ላይ ጥቃት የፈጸሙ ሲሆን በተደጋጋሚ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎችን በመገንባት ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እና የሰፈራ መስፋፋት በክልሉ የሚኖሩ የፍልስጤም ማህበረሰቦችን ህይወት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ጥሏል።
oromo: Humnooni Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa Dhihaatti raayyaa halkan guutuu adeemsisaniin ijoollee lama dabalatee lammiilee Falasxiin torba qabanii hidhaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, qubattoonni Israa'el qonnaan bultoota irratti miidhaa geessisuu fi bakkeewwan seeraan alaa qubachuuf ijaarruu ittuma fufaniiru. Gochootni kunneen naannichatti hojiilee waraanaa fi babal'ina qubata lafaa guyyuu adeemsifamuun ummata Falasxiin irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa jiru.

title: At least three killed in explosion near cafe in Russia’s Moscow
english: An explosion occurred near a cafe in Moscow's Kudrinskaya Square on Saturday evening, resulting in at least three deaths and 15 injuries. Emergency services have been deployed to the scene to assist the wounded, and surrounding traffic and metro entrances have been closed. Local authorities are currently investigating the cause of the blast.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ምሽት በሞስኮ ኩድሪንስካያ አደባባይ በሚገኝ ካፌ አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረ ፍንዳታ ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 15 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሰራተኞች ጉዳት ለደረሰባቸው ሰዎች ህክምና እየሰጡ ሲሆን የፍንዳታውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ነው። አካባቢውም ለጊዜው ተዘግቶ በመቆየቱ የትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ተስተጓጉሏል።
oromo: Dilbata galgala magaalaa Moskoo bakka Kudrinskaya Square jedhamuutti, nyaataaf dhugaatii keessatti kan hundaa'e bakka tokko biratti dhuka'iinsa mudateen lubbuun namoota saddeetiif sadii darbeera; namoonni 15 ammoo miidhamaniiru. Tajaajilli ariifachiisaa miidhamtootaaf gargaarsa godhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, qorannoon sababa dhuka'iinsichaa ilaalchisee jalqabameera. Bakki dhuka'iinsichi itti mudate kunis guutummaatti cufamee tajaajilli konkolaataa fi imaltootaa addaan citee jira.

title: Seven killed by Israeli strikes today: Gaza civil defence agency
english: The Palestinian Civil Defence agency reports that at least seven people have been killed in Gaza following Israeli strikes today. Among the victims were two individuals struck by a drone while on a rooftop in Gaza City. This violence follows Hamas's recent acceptance of a new ceasefire proposal drafted by the United States.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ሲቪል መከላከያ ኤጀንሲ ዛሬ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን አስታውቋል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል በጋዛ ከተማ ባሉ የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ጣሪያ ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት የተገደሉ ሁለት ሰዎች ይገኙበታል። ይህ ጥቃት ሃማስ በአሜሪካ የተዘጋጀውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በይፋ ከተቀበለ አንድ ቀን በኋላ መከሰቱ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Hojii gaggeessitoonni ittisa sivilii Falasxiin akka ibsanitti, guyyaa har'aa haleellaa Israa'el iddoowwan adda addaatti geggeessiteen namoonni gara torba ta'an du'aniiru. Namoota du'an keessa namoonni lama magaalaa Gaazaatti mana irra taa'aa osoo jiranu haleellaa doonii (drone) qilleensarraa isaan dhaqqateen lubbuun isaanii darbe. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, gareen Hamaas waliigaltee waraana dhaabuu kan Ameerikaan qopha'e fudhachuu isaa guyyaa tokko booda dha.

title: Evening recap
english: Tensions are rising across the Middle East as US embassies warn citizens to leave the region due to fears of escalation between the US and Iran. Violent incidents continue with drone strikes in Kuwait, Israeli military actions in Gaza and Lebanon, and ongoing instability in the West Bank. Meanwhile, the UK government is considering stricter measures against Israeli settlers, while the Houthis have dismissed claims that they are charging fees for ship passage.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ ሊቀጥል ይችላል በሚል ስጋት፣ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲዎች ዜጎቻቸው አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ አሳስበዋል። በኩዌት የድሮን ጥቃቶች እየተፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ በጋዛ እና በሊባኖስም የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ቀጥለዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ የብሪታንያ መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኙ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ እያሰበ ሲሆን፣ ሁቲዎችም በመርከቦች ላይ ክፍያ የመጫን እቅድ እንዳላቸው የሚነገረውን ወሬ አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti waraanni dabaluu danda'a soda jedhuun, imbaasinoonni Amerikaa kan naannoo sanaa jiran lammiileen isaanii akka biyyaa bahan akeekkachiiseera. Kuwait keessatti weerarri roonii kan gaggeeffamaa jiru yoo ta'u, Gaazaa fi Libaanoos keessattis tarkaanfiin waraanaa Israa'el itti fufee jira. Gamtaan Mootummoota Gamtoomanii (UK) qe'ee qaban irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'aa kan jiru yoo ta'u, gareen Huutii immoo dooniiwwan karaa galaana diimaa darban irraa qarshii kaffalchiisuuf yaada qabaachuu isaanii haaleera.

title: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert
english: Italy has placed almost all its major cities on the highest heat alert as a powerful heatwave sweeps across the country. Authorities warn that the extreme temperatures pose a serious health risk to everyone, not just vulnerable groups, and advise staying indoors during peak heat. This intense weather is caused by a subtropical anticyclone from North Africa, which is also contributing to dangerous wildfire conditions throughout Europe.
amharic: ጣሊያን አገሪቱን ባጠቃው ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል ምክንያት በአብዛኛዎቹ ዋና ዋና ከተሞቿ ላይ ከፍተኛውን የሙቀት ማስጠንቀቂያ አውጇል። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ለተጋላጭ ቡድኖች ብቻ ሳይሆን ለሁሉም ሰው የጤና ስጋት ስለሚፈጥር በሙቀቱ ሰዓት ከቤት እንዳይወጡ መክረዋል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ መዛባት የመጣው ከሰሜን አፍሪካ በመጣ የሙቀት አየር ሲሆን፣ በሌሎች የአውሮፓ አገራትም ለሰደድ እሳት መነሳሳት አስተዋጽኦ እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Xaliyaanin dhibee hoo'a cimaa biyyattii mudateen wal qabatee, magaalonni ishee gurguddoon hedduun sadarkaa akeekkachiisa olaanaa irra akka jiran beeksisteerti. Hoo'i kun namoota hundaaf balaa fayyaa waan qabuuf, namoonni yeroo hoo'i cimaan jiru keessatti manaa akka hin baane fi of eeggannoo akka taasisan gorfamaniiru. Hoo'i cimaan kun qilleensa garaa garaa Afrikaa kaabaa irraa dhufteen kan uumame yoo ta'u, biyyoota Awurooppaa biroo keessattis ibidda bosonaa babal'isuuf sababa ta'ee jira.

title: ‘Marathon’ shines light on Gaza’s orphaned children and humanitarian crisis
english: In Khan Younis, Gaza, children held a symbolic marathon to draw global attention to the severe humanitarian crisis and the tens of thousands of orphans created by the ongoing conflict. With over 58,000 children having lost one or both parents, the event highlighted the urgent need for psychosocial support and protection for those suffering from the war's devastating effects. The race served as a platform for families to share their experiences of loss and displacement while advocating for greater assistance for Gaza’s vulnerable youth.
amharic: በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ ከተማ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ወላጆቻቸውን ላጡ ህጻናት የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ትኩረት ለመስጠት ተምሳሌታዊ የሩጫ ውድድር ተካሂዷል። ከ58,000 በላይ ህጻናት ወላጆቻቸውን ባጡበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ ይህ ዝግጅት ለተጎጂዎች አስቸኳይ የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ እና ጥበቃ እንደሚያስፈልግ ለማሳሰብ ያለመ ነው። ዝግጅቱ ህጻናት እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው በጦርነቱ የደረሰባቸውን መከራ እንዲገልጹ እድል የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው ጥሪ አቅርቧል።
oromo: Magaalaa Khan Yuunis kan Gazaatti, ijoollee waraanaan maatiisaanii dhaban gargaaruuf fi dhimmi isaanii addunyaatti akka dhaga’amuuf fiigichi mallattoo ta’e tokko godhameera. Ijoolleen 58,000 ol ta’an waraana kana keessatti warra isaanii dhabuun isaanii kan ibsame yoo ta’u, ijoollee kanneeniif deeggarsi sammuu fi nageenyaa yeroodhaan akka barbaachisu dhaamsa dabarseera. Fiigichi kun ijoolleen fi maatiinsaanii miidhaa waraanaan irra ga’e akka himatan carraa kenneera.

title: Trump pledges to pursue ‘anti-weaponisation’ fund amid Blanche standoff
english: President Trump has threatened to revive a controversial taxpayer-funded program if the Senate does not confirm his attorney general nominee, Todd Blanche. Some Republican senators are currently blocking Blanche’s appointment due to concerns that the fund would be used to reward political allies. Trump suggested he might bypass the confirmation process and continue keeping Blanche in the role as acting attorney general.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የሴኔቱ ምክር ቤት የጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ እጩ የሆኑትን ቶድ ብላንችን ካላፀደቁ፣ አወዛጋቢ የሆነውን የመንግስት ገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንደገና እንደሚጀምሩ አስፈራርተዋል። አንዳንድ የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ይህ ገንዘብ የፖለቲካ አጋሮችን ለመሸለም ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል በሚል ስጋት የብላንችን ሹመት በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው። ትራምፕ ይህንን የሹመት ሂደት በማለፍ ብላንች በጊዜያዊነት በስልጣን እንዲቀጥሉ ሊያደርጉ እንደሚችሉ ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp yoo Senaatiin mudamaa isaanitiif Todd Blanche ta'an hin raggaasisu ta'e, qophii maallaqa mootummaa mormii guddaa kaase deebisanii akka jalqaban doorsisaniiru. Senaatooroonni Rippaabilikaanii tokko tokko maallaqni kun michoota siyaasaa badhaasuuf oola jedhanii waan shakkaniif mudamaa isaanii kana mormaa jiru. Traamp adeemsa raggaasisuu kana darbuudhaan Blanche itti gaafatamaa ta'anii akka itti fufan godhuu akka danda'an ibsaniiru.

title: At least 9 people killed in Russian missile attacks on Kyiv
english: A series of Russian missile strikes hit the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv early Saturday morning, causing at least nine deaths. The assault resulted in over a dozen explosions throughout the city and left many more people injured. Emergency efforts are currently underway to assist the victims of this violent attack.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ማለዳ ላይ በዩክሬን ዋና ከተማ ኪየቭ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተረጋግጧል። በከተማዋ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ከደርዘን በላይ ፍንዳታዎች የተሰሙ ሲሆን በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ዜጎች ለመርዳት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች እየተከናወኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dilbata ganama magaalaa guddittii Yukreen Kiiyiv irratti haleellaa gombisaa (missile) Raashiyaan gaggeessiteen namoonni sagal lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaa kana hordofee magaallattii keessatti dhukaatiiwwan gurguddoon hedduun kan dhagahaman yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduun ammoo madaa'aniiru. Miidhamtoota gargaaruuf tattaaffiin fayyisuu fi gargaarsa ariifachiisaa taasifamaa jira.

title: Care for a dirty soda? How this drink trend became a US obsession
english: The 'dirty soda' trend, which involves mixing fountain sodas with cream, syrups, and fruit purees, has become a massive sensation across the United States. It originated in 2010 when Nicole Tanner launched her company, Swig, aiming to provide an affordable, highly customizable treat for families. The concept gained widespread popularity through social media and now serves as a popular social destination for consumers looking for unique drink combinations.
amharic: የ'ደርቲ ሶዳ' (dirty soda) አዝማሚያ፣ ማለትም ለስላሳ መጠጦችን ከክሬም፣ ከሲሮፕ እና ከፍራፍሬ ጭማቂ ጋር በመቀላቀል የሚዘጋጅ መጠጥ በአሜሪካ በጣም ተወዳጅ እየሆነ መጥቷል። ይህ ሀሳብ በ2010 ኒኮል ታነር 'ስዊግ' (Swig) የተባለውን ድርጅት ሲመሰርቱ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ለቤተሰቦች ርካሽ እና እንደ ፍላጎታቸው ሊዘጋጅ የሚችል መጠጥ ለማቅረብ ታስቦ የተፈጠረ ነው። ይህ አሰራር በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመሰራጨቱ አሁን ብዙዎች ልዩ ጣዕም ያላቸውን መጠጦች ለመቅመስ የሚሰበሰቡበት ተወዳጅ ማዕከል ሆኗል።
oromo: Trendii 'dirty soda' jedhamu kan soda ykn dhugaatii laafaa garaa garaa waliin kirimii, siroopii fi xuuxa ija mukaa makuun qopha'u kun, yeroo ammaa biyya Ameerikaa keessatti baay'ee beekamaa ta'eera. Yaanni kun kan jalqabame bara 2010 yoo ta'u, Nicole Tanner jedhamtu dhaabbata 'Swig' jedhamu kan hundessite maatiin gatii salphaan akka dhugaatii adda ta'e argatan yaaddee dha. Akkaataa dhugaatii kanaa kun miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti beekamtii argatee, yeroo ammaa namoonni dhugaatii adda ta'e kana qabachuuf bakka itti walga'anitti jijjiirameera.

title: Israeli forces detain residents and demolish homes in southern Syria
english: Following the removal of the Assad regime, Israeli military forces have crossed the 1974 disengagement line into southern Syria. These troops are currently occupying territory, conducting home demolitions, and detaining local residents. There are currently no indications that the Israeli military intends to withdraw from these regions.

title: Burnham says UK exploring measures against Israeli settlements in West Bank
english: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is considering new, stricter actions against Israeli settlements in the West Bank following ongoing violence against Palestinians. This move follows a recent international court ruling that identified these settlements as a violation of global law. While the UK previously issued trade guidance, the government is now evaluating further measures to address the situation.

oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Biriiteen Andy Burnham miidhaa fi haleellaa filisxeemota irratti raawwatamaa jiru dhaabsisuuf, naannoo West Bankiitti babal'achuu qubannaa Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf karoorfachaa jiru. Murtoon kun kan dhufe erga Mana Murtii Haqaa Addunyaatiin qubannoon kunneen seeraan alaa ta'uun isaanii mirkanaa'ee booda dha. Biriiteen kanaan dura qajeelfama daldalaa kan baaste yoo ta'u, amma garuu tarkaanfiiwwan dabalataa fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jirti.

title: Turkiye and Iraq sign one-year oil pipeline deal amid global shift
english: Turkiye and Iraq have signed a one-year agreement to resume oil transportation through the Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline, allowing for 750,000 barrels per day to be exported. This deal serves as a crucial alternative route for Iraq, which has faced significant export challenges following recent disruptions in the Gulf. Both nations view this partnership as a strategic step to stabilize energy supplies while they negotiate a more permanent, long-term framework.
amharic: ቱርክ እና ኢራቅ በኪርኩክ-ሴይሃን የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር በኩል በቀን 750,000 በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ለመላክ የአንድ ዓመት ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ በተፈጠሩ ችግሮች ምክንያት ለተቸገረችው ኢራቅ የነዳጅ ምርቷን ወደ ውጭ የምትልክበት ወሳኝ አማራጭ መንገድ ሆኗል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ይህንን ስምምነት የረጅም ጊዜ አጋርነታቸውን የሚያጠናክር ስትራቴጂካዊ እርምጃ አድርገው ይመለከቱታል።
oromo: Turkiifi Iraaq daandii isaan kutaadhaan wal-qunnamsiisuun guyyaatti boba'aa barmeela 750,000 akka ergan waliigaltee waggaa tokkoo mallatteessaniiru. Waliigaltichi biyya Iraaq miidhaa naannoo Gulf keessatti isheen muudate booda boba'aa ishee gabaa biyya alaa baasuuf filannoo barbaachisaa ta'eefii jira. Mootummootni lamaan kunneen walitti dhufeenya kana gara fuulduraatti walta'iinsa cimaa fi dhaabbataa ta'etti guddisuuf akka hojjetan ibsaniiru.

title: UN mission in Lebanon criticises Israeli incursions
english: The United Nations has raised alarms regarding Israeli military actions in southern Lebanon, noting that these operations violate established ceasefire agreements. Recent large-scale explosions near the historic Beaufort Castle have caused significant damage to local infrastructure and cultural heritage sites. UN officials emphasized that these destructive activities are severely harming both civilian property and the historical identity of the region.

oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa tarkaanfii waraana Israa'el kibba Libanon keessatti fudhachaa jirtu waliigaltee tasgabbii cabsuu ishee ibsee balaaleeffateera. Dhukaatiniifi diiggiin biiroon kun biyyaatti gaggeessaa jiru miidhaa guddaa bu'uuraalee misoomaafi bakkeewwan seena-qabeeyyii irratti geessisaa jira. Keessattuu, naannoo gamoo seena-qabeessa 'Beaufort Castle' jedhamutti dhukaatiniifi diiggiin gaggeeffame kun dhaloota dhufuuf kan miidhu ta'uu mootummoonni kun beeksisaniiru.

title: Israel says it killed three Hezbollah fighters despite ceasefire
english: The Israeli military reported killing three Hezbollah fighters in southern Lebanon, asserting the action was necessary to address a security threat. This incident occurred on the Ali Taher ridge, an area currently occupied by Israeli forces near a historical site. The operation is being viewed as a breach of the ongoing ceasefire agreement between the two sides.

oromo: Waraanni Israa'el loltoota Hizbullah sadii kibba Libaanoos keessatti ajjeesuusaa beeksiseera. Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte soda nageenyaa ittisuuf ta'uushee ibsiteetti. Hojiin kun kan raawwatame bakka humnoonni Israa'el to'annoo isaanii jala oolchanitti ta'ee, walii galtee tasgabbii waraanaa dhiyoo as godhame kan cabsu ta'uun ibsameera.

title: US embassies tell citizens to 'consider departing' Middle East
english: US embassies across the Middle East are advising American citizens to think about leaving the region due to rising tensions between the US and Iran. Officials warn that the political situation could worsen quickly, potentially leading to flight delays and restricted travel. Americans currently in the area are encouraged to remain vigilant and avoid locations that might be associated with US interests.

oromo: Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti wal dhabdee dabalaa dhufe hordofee, embasiin Amerikaa biyyoota Baha Giddu galeessa keessatti argaman lammiileen isaanii naannicha akka gadi lakkisan gorsa kennaniiru. Haalli kun yeroodhuma keessatti hamachuu danda'a waan ta'eef, adeemsi balaliii xiyyaaraa fi imalli gufachuun isaa hin oolu. Lammiileen Amerikaa naannicha keessa jiran of eeggannoo cimaa akka godhanii fi bakkeewwan Amerikaa wajjin wal qabatanii mul'atan irraa akka fagaatan akeekkachiifameera.

title: Moroccan rapper Mehdi El Youbi temporarily released from prison
english: Moroccan rapper Mehdi El Youbi, known as Mehdi Black Wind, has been granted temporary release from a Casablanca prison after being detained for 18 days. He remains under prosecution for allegedly insulting a constitutional institution, a charge that could lead to a prison sentence of up to two years. The artist, who has been based in France since 2017, is currently waiting for his next court hearing scheduled for October 2, 2026.
amharic: ሜህዲ ኤል ዩቢ በመባል የሚታወቀው ሞሮኮአዊው ራፐር ሜህዲ ብላክ ዊንድ ለ18 ቀናት ከታሰረ በኋላ ከካዛብላንካ እስር ቤት በጊዜያዊነት ተፈቷል። አርቲስቱ ህገ-መንግስታዊ ተቋማትን ሰድቧል በሚል ክስ እየተካሄደበት ሲሆን፣ ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ ከተገኘ እስከ ሁለት ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊቀጣ ይችላል። ከ2017 ጀምሮ በፈረንሳይ ይኖር የነበረው ይህ አርቲስት፣ ቀጣይ የፍርድ ቤት ቀጠሮውን በጥቅምት 2 ቀን 2026 ይጠባበቃል።
oromo: Raapparichi biyya Morookoo Mehdi El Youbi ykn Mehdi Black Wind jedhamu, guyyoota 18 erga hidhamee booda mana hidhaa Kaazaablaankaa irraa gadi lakkifameera. Abbaan ogummaa kun bara 2017 irraa eegalee Faransaay kan jiraatu yoo ta'u, gubaa mana murtii itti aanu kan qabameef Onkoloolessa 2, 2026 dha.

title: Israeli strikes kill four across Gaza, destroy medical supply warehouse
english: Recent Israeli airstrikes across Gaza resulted in at least four deaths and the destruction of vital medicine warehouses at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital. These attacks occurred shortly after a disarmament agreement was reached, drawing strong condemnation from health officials who labeled the destruction of medical supplies a heinous act. The strikes also damaged nearby shelters, forcing displaced families to flee once again.

oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el ganda Gaza keessatti raawwateen namoonni afur du'anii, mana kuusa qorichaa kan hospitaala Al-Aqsa Martyrs keessa jiru barbadaa'eera. Haleellaan kun walii galtee meeshaa waraanaa hiikuu booda kan raawwatame waan ta'eef, aangotni fayyaa qoricha barbadeessuu kana balaaleffataniiru. Haleellaan kun bakka buqqaatonni qubatanii jiran irrattis miidhaa geessisee, maatiin sun akka lammata buqqa'an dirqisiiseera.

title: At least 11 wounded by Colombia car bomb days before presidential election
english: A car bomb exploded in the Colombian city of Cucuta, leaving 11 people injured just days before the country's new president takes office. No organization has claimed responsibility for the attack, which targeted police near the Venezuelan border. The incoming president, Abelardo de la Espriella, condemned the violence and vowed to maintain a tough stance against criminal groups and rebels.
amharic: ኮሎምቢያ ውስጥ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ስልጣን ከመረከባቸው ጥቂት ቀናት ቀደም ብሎ ኩኩታ በተባለች ከተማ በደረሰ የመኪና ቦምብ ፍንዳታ 11 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በፖሊስ ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ ሲሆን እስካሁን የትኛውም ቡድን ሀላፊነቱን አልወሰደም። ወደ ስልጣን የሚመጡት አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪዬላ ጥቃቱን በማውገዝ በታጣቂ ቡድኖች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaatti guyyoota muraasa dura biyyattiin pirezidaantii haaraa filatte muuduuf jettu, magaala Kukuutaa keessatti konkolaataa keessa hidhamee turee dhahuun namoota 11 miidheera. Haleellaa buufata poolisii cinaatti raawwate kanaaf gareen itti gaafatamummaa fudhate hin jiru. Pirezidaantiin filataman Abelardo de la Espriella haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, gareewwan yakka raawwatan irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu waadaa galaniiru.

title: Two ex-Sri Lanka officials sentenced to death over 2019 Easter bombings
english: A Sri Lankan court has sentenced a former police chief and a top defense official to death for failing to act on intelligence warnings ahead of the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. These attacks on hotels and churches resulted in hundreds of deaths, and the convicted officials intend to appeal the verdict. While the court issued death sentences, they are likely to result in life imprisonment due to the country's long-standing moratorium on executions.
amharic: የስሪላንካ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞ የፖሊስ አዛዥን እና ከፍተኛ የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ባለስልጣንን በ2019 በትንሳኤ በዓል ዕለት ለደረሰው የቦምብ ጥቃት በቂ ጥንቃቄ አላደረጉም በሚል የሞት ፍርድ ፈረደባቸው። በሆቴሎች እና አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ላይ በተፈጸመው በዚህ ጥቃት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥፋተኛ የተባሉት ግለሰቦችም ፍርዱን እንደሚቃወሙ አስታውቀዋል። በስሪላንካ የሞት ቅጣት ተግባራዊ ባለመሆኑ፣ ፍርዱ ምናልባትም እድሜ ልክ እስራት ሊቀየር ይችላል።
oromo: Mana murtii Siraalankaa ajajaan poolisii duraanii fi qondaaltuun ittisa biyyaa duraanii tokko, bara 2019 ayyaana Faasikaa irratti qophii boombii hordofee gorsa tikaa dhabaniiru jedhee du’atti murteesse. Hojiiwwan shororkeessummaa hootelotaa fi waldaalee kiristaanaa irratti raawwataman kunneen lubbuu namoota dhibbaan lakkaa’amanii galaafataniiru. Namoonni himataman kunis murtee kana mormuuf karoorfataniiru. Siraalankaa keessatti adabbiin du’aa waggoota hedduuf waan hin raawwatamneef, murteen kun gara hidhaa guutuu jireenyaatti jijjiiramuun isaa hin oolu.

title: India cracks down on protesters accused of ‘abusing’ Modi
english: Indian authorities are taking legal action and removing social media content involving protesters who participated in recent demonstrations against the government. These individuals are being accused of insulting Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the movement. While the Prime Minister publicly stated he forgives those he considers misled, the government crackdown on participants continues.
amharic: የህንድ ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በመንግስት ላይ ተቃውሞ ሲያደርጉ የነበሩ ሰዎችን በህግ እየቀጡ ሲሆን ከማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጾቻቸው ላይም ይዘቶችን እያስወገዱ ይገኛል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲን ስድብ ሰድበዋል በሚል ክስ እየቀረበባቸው ነው። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ግለሰቦቹን ይቅር እንዳሏቸው ቢናገሩም በመንግስት በኩል የሚወሰደው እርምጃ ግን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Mootummaan Hindii namoota dhiheenya kana mormii geggeessaa turan irratti tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachaa fi miidiyaalee hawaasaa irraa ergaawwan isaanii haqaa jira. Namoonni kun mormii kana irratti ministira muummee Narendra Modii arrabsaniiru jedhamanii shakkamu. Ministirri muummee namoota kana akka dhiifama godhaniif ibsan illee, mootummaan namoota mormii kana irratti hirmaatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu itti fufeera.

title: Israeli strike destroys Gaza hospital warehouse
english: An Israeli airstrike has demolished a storage facility containing vital medical supplies intended for the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital located in Deir al-Balah, Gaza. Hospital employees reported the destruction of these essential resources, which are critical for patient care during the ongoing conflict. At this time, the Israeli military has not provided a statement regarding the incident.
amharic: የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ዲር አል-ባላህ የሚገኘው የአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል የህክምና ቁሳቁስ ማከማቻ መጋዘን አውድሟል። የሆስፒታሉ ሰራተኞች ለታካሚዎች ህክምና አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች ሙሉ በሙሉ መውደማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ የሰጠው አስተያየት የለም።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el qilleensa irraa haleellaa raawwateen, gabaa mana kuusaa qorichaafi meeshaalee fayyaa kan hospitaala Al-Aqsa Martyrs kan magaala Deir al-Balah keessatti argamu barbadeesseera. Hojjettoonni hospitaalichaa akka ibsanitti, meeshaaleen fayyaa gargaarsa hatattamaaf oolu turan kun hundinuu manca'aniiru. Humni waraana Israa'el hanga yoonaatti haleellaa kana ilaalchisee ibsa tokkollee hin kennine.

title: Infantino’s FIFA crisis: What is reaction to World Cup investment U-turn?
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has canceled a controversial plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and other major tournaments to private investors following intense global backlash. Major football organizations, including UEFA, expressed significant disapproval of the proposal and highlighted a breakdown in trust toward FIFA's leadership. While the plan has been dropped, football authorities emphasized that significant efforts are now required to rebuild confidence and ensure the sport is managed through collective consultation.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን እና ሌሎች ዋና ዋና ውድድሮችን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ አቅደው የነበረውን አወዛጋቢ ውሳኔ ከዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ በኋላ ሰርዘዋል። እንደ ዩኤፋ ያሉ ዋና ዋና የእግር ኳስ አስተዳደር አካላት ለዚህ እቅድ ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ቅሬታ በመግለጽ፣ በፊፋ አመራር ላይ ያላቸው እምነት መሸርሸሩን አስታውቀዋል። እቅዱ ቢሰረዝም፣ የእግር ኳስ ተቋማት አመኔታን መልሶ ለመገንባት እና ስፖርቱ በጋራ ምክክር እንዲመራ ለማድረግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiinoo, mootummaan kubbaa miilaa addunyaa dorgommiiwwan gurguddoo akka Waancaa Addunyaa irratti qooda fayyadamaa dhuunfaa galchuuf karoorse ture mormii cimaa addunyaa guutuu irraa isa mudate hordofee haqeera. Akka UEFA fa'i dhaabbileen kubbaa miilaa gurguddoon karoora kana mormuudhaan, hogganoota FIFA irratti amantiin qaban akka bade ibsaniiru. Karoorri kun haquusaa hordofee, qaamoleen kubbaa miilaa amantii deebisanii horachuufi marii waloo irratti hundaa'uudhaan guddina ispoortichaa mirkaneessuun barbaachisaa ta'uu hubachiisaniiru.

title: Is Spain being punished?
english: A massive surge of migrants recently entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, resulting in dozens of deaths and leading Spain to declare a state of emergency. Israeli officials have used this crisis to criticize Spain's immigration policies, accusing the country of hypocrisy due to its recent diplomatic stances against Israel. This tension follows Spain’s official recognition of Palestine and its public condemnation of Israeli military actions, further highlighting the ongoing diplomatic friction between the two nations.
amharic: በቅርቡ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ስደተኞች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሱዌታ በገቡበት ወቅት በአስር የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ይህም ስፔን የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ እንድታውጅ አስገድዷታል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ይህንን ቀውስ በመጠቀም የስፔንን የኢሚግሬሽን ፖሊሲ በመተቸት፣ አገሪቱ በእስራኤል ላይ በወሰደችው የቅርብ ጊዜ የዲፕሎማሲ አቋም ምክንያት በድርብ መመዘኛ ትወቅሳለች። ይህ ውዝግብ የተፈጠረው ስፔን ፍልስጤምን በይፋ እውቅና መስጠቷን እና የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች በግልፅ መቃወሟን ተከትሎ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ቅራኔ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Godina Ispeen kan Ceuta jedhamu keessatti baqattoonni hedduun seenuusaanii hordofee lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbeera; kunis Ispeen labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa akka labsitu dirqisiiseera. Aangeyyoonni Israa'el rakkoo kana fayyadamuun imaammata godaantotaa kan Ispeen komachuuf yaalan, akkasumas Ispeen Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii diippiloomaasii fudhatteef 'fakkina' jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe erga Ispeen biyya Filisxeem beekamtii kennitee fi tarkaanfii waraana Israa'el balaaleffattee booda, dhimmi kunis hariiroo diippiloomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan jabeessuudha.

title: Children run marathon to spotlight Gaza’s growing orphan crises
english: Hundreds of children recently participated in a marathon held in Gaza to draw global attention to the rising number of orphans caused by the ongoing war. Organized by the International Networking for Humanitarian, the event aimed to showcase the difficult circumstances these youngsters face. The organizers also used the race to appeal for increased local and international support for these vulnerable children.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ወላጆቻቸውን ላጡ ህጻናት ትኩረት ለመስጠት ማራቶን አድርገዋል። ይህ በአለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ ድርጅት የተዘጋጀው መርሃ ግብር፣ ወላጅ አልባ ህጻናት የሚያጋጥሟቸውን ችግሮች ለማስተዋወቅ ያለመ ነው። አዘጋጆቹ በውድድሩ አማካኝነት ለነዚህ ህጻናት የበለጠ የሀገር ውስጥ እና የአለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti ijoolleen dhibbaan lakkaa’aman waraana kanaan maatii isaanii dhaban yaadachuuf fi xiyyeeffannoo argachuuf fiigicha maaraatoonii geggeessaniiru. Qophiin kun dhaabbata gargaarsa namoomaa idil-addunyaatiin kan qophaa’e yoo ta’u, kaayyoon isaas ijoolleen maatii dhaban rakkoo keessa jiran hawaasa addunyaatti agarsiisuudha. Qindeessitootni sagantaa kanaa, ijoollee rakkoo kana keessa jiraniif deeggarsa dabalataa akka godhamu gaafataniru.

title: Most Australian teens still online three months after under-16 ban
english: A recent report reveals that over 80 percent of Australian teenagers continue to use social media three months after the government implemented an under-16 ban. Regulators found that tech companies have not successfully enforced age verification, allowing minors to keep or create new accounts easily. Despite the government's efforts to protect youth mental health, the frequency of social media use among children remains largely unchanged.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ መንግስት ከ16 ዓመት በታች ለሆኑ ታዳጊዎች የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አጠቃቀምን ከከለከለ ሶስት ወራት በኋላ፣ ከ80 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆኑ ታዳጊዎች አሁንም መድረኮቹን እየተጠቀሙ መሆኑን አንድ ሪፖርት አመልክቷል። የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች እድሜን የማረጋገጥ ስራን በአግባቡ ባለመተግበራቸው ታዳጊዎች በቀላሉ አካውንታቸውን ለማቆየት ወይም አዲስ ለመክፈት ችለዋል። መንግስት የታዳጊዎችን የአእምሮ ጤና ለመጠበቅ ይህንን እገዳ ቢጥልም፣ በልጆች የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አጠቃቀም ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ መምጣት አልቻለም።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa tokko akka agarsiisutti, mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa umriin isaanii waggaa 16 gadi ta’an miidiyaalee hawaasaa akka hin fayyadamne dhorkee ji’a sadii boodallee, dargaggoonni 80 irra hedduun isaanii fayyadamuu itti fufaniiru. Dhaabbileen teeknoolojii umrii mirkaneessuuf tarkaanfii barbaachisu waan hin fudhanneef, ijoolleen salphaatti heeyyama argachuu ykn akkaataa haarawa banachuu danda’aniiru. Mootummaan fayyaa sammuu ijoollee eeguuf jecha dhorkaa kana kaa’us, fayyadamiinsi miidiyaalee hawaasaa ijoollee gidduutti jijjiirama guddaa hin agarsiisne.

title: Spain says migrants leaving Ceuta after mass influx in which 67 died
english: Nearly 60,000 migrants who recently surged into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta have returned to Morocco, following a chaotic period that left at least 67 people dead. The massive influx caused significant diplomatic concern across the European Union, prompting leaders to discuss tighter border controls. Spanish authorities are now working to secure the area and prevent future unauthorized crossings.
amharic: በቅርቡ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሱኡታ በብዛት የገቡት ወደ 60,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች ወደ ሞሮኮ መመለሳቸውን ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የሰው እንቅስቃሴ ቢያንስ 67 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን በአውሮፓ ህብረት ሀገራት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ውዝግብን አስነስቷል። የስፔን መንግስት ድንበሩን ለመቆጣጠር እና መሰል ክስተቶችን ለመከላከል ተጨማሪ ጥበቃዎችን እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Godansa guddaa gara magaalaa Se'uta kan Ispeenitti argamutti godhame booda, namoonni 60,000 ol ta'an gara biyyatti deebi'anii jiru. Yeroo kana keessatti namoonni 67 lubbuun kan darban yoo ta'u, kunis mootummoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. Mootummaan Ispeen daangaa isaa jabeessuufi gara fuulduraatti godansa akkanaa akkasumaan akka hin gaggeeffamneef tarkaanfii fudhachaa jira.

title: GCC condemns Iranian attacks in Kuwait
english: The Gulf Cooperation Council has strongly condemned Iran for allegedly targeting civilian sites and private vehicles in Kuwait. The council's secretary general described these actions as a hostile violation of Kuwaiti sovereignty and a dangerous threat to regional security. Officials are calling these attacks a direct attempt to undermine the stability and safety of the nation.
amharic: የባህረ ሰላጤው የትብብር ምክር ቤት ኢራን በኩዌት ውስጥ በሲቪል ተቋማት እና በግል ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት አድርሳለች በሚል አጥብቆ አውግዟል። የምክር ቤቱ ዋና ጸሐፊ ድርጊቱን የኩዌትን ሉዓላዊነት የጣሰ እና ለክልሉ ሰላም ስጋት የፈጠረ የጥቃት ሙከራ ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው መረጋጋትን ለማደፍረስ የሚደረግ ተደጋጋሚ ጠበኝነት እንደሆነም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Gumii Walta'iinsa Goolfii (GCC) Iran, Kuweet keessatti bu'uuraalee iddoo siviilotaa fi konkolaattota dhuunfaa irratti haleellaa raawwatte jechuun balaaleffateera. Hoji gaggeessaan gumichaa, haleellaan kun kabajamuu biyyattii kan sarbuu fi nageenya naannichaa kan booressu ta'uu ibseera. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii fi nageenya lammiilee Kuweet irratti yaaddoo kallattii uumuu isaas hubachiiseera.

title: Spanish minister clashes with Israeli diplomat over migrants entering Ceuta
english: A significant diplomatic row has erupted between Spain and Israel after roughly 60,000 migrants crossed into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco. Israeli officials criticized Spain's immigration management while suggesting Spain's colonial presence in Africa is hypocritical, prompting Spanish ministers to imply that Israel and the U.S. may be fueling the crisis in retaliation for Spain's stance on Gaza. While many migrants have since returned to Morocco, the event has triggered intense political tension and prompted neighboring European nations to tighten border security.
amharic: ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ ከ60,000 በላይ ስደተኞች መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ በስፔን እና በእስራኤል መካከል ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ አለመግባባት ተፈጥሯል። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት የስፔንን የስደተኞች አያያዝ በመተቸት ስፔን በአፍሪካ የምትይዘው የቅኝ ግዛት ግዛት እንዳላት ማውሳታቸው፣ የስፔን ባለስልጣናት ደግሞ እስራኤል እና አሜሪካ በጋዛ ጦርነት ላይ የስፔን አቋም በመቃወም ለዚህ ቀውስ ምክንያት ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ እንዲጠራጠሩ አድርጓቸዋል። አብዛኞቹ ስደተኞች ወደ ሞሮኮ የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት በስፔን እና በአጎራባች የአውሮፓ ሀገራት መካከል ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Godina Si'uta jedhamtu kan Ispeen keessatti godaantotni kuma 60 ol seenuun isaa, mootummoota Ispeen fi Israa'el gidduutti wal dhabdee diploomaasii guddaa uumeera. Jilaan Israa'el to'annoo godaantotaa kan Ispeen komachuun akkasumas lafa koloni ta'e Afrikaa keessa jiru irratti qeequun, Ispeen ammoo Israa'el fi Ameerikaan mormii Ispeen waraana Gaaza irratti qabduun wal qabatee rakkoo kana akka uuman shakkitu ibsiteetti. Godaantotni hedduun gara Morookootti deebi'anis, ta'een kun walitti dhufeenya siyaasaa Ispeen fi biyyoota Awurooppaa kan biroo gidduutti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Tigray’s Youth are Breaking the TPLF’s Narrative Monopoly
english: For decades, the TPLF maintained strict control over Tigray’s political narrative by suppressing independent media and using state-controlled outlets to enforce its agenda. However, the rise of social media and digital platforms has enabled younger generations to challenge this monopoly, exposing the party's failures and promoting diverse political viewpoints. As the party's traditional grip on information weakens, it is losing its ability to silence dissent, signaling a major shift toward a more open and critical political environment in the region.
amharic: ለበርካታ አሥርት ዓመታት ህወሓት ነጻ ሚዲያዎችን በማፈን እና በመንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ መገናኛ ብዙሃን አማካኝነት የትግራይን የፖለቲካ ትርክት ተቆጣጥሮ ቆይቷል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መስፋፋት ወጣቶች የፓርቲውን የፕሮፓጋንዳ ማሽን እንዲገዳደሩ እና የፓርቲውን ውድቀቶች በማጋለጥ አማራጭ ሃሳቦችን እንዲያቀርቡ አስችሏቸዋል። ይህ የፓርቲው የመረጃ የበላይነት መዳከም በትግራይ የፖለቲካ ምህዳር ውስጥ የነበረውን የፍርሃት አገዛዝ በመሸርሸር፣ ይበልጥ ግልጽ እና ውይይት የሚደረግበት አዲስ ምዕራፍ እየተከፈተ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan TPLF waggoota dheeraaf miidiyaalee bilisa ta'an ugguruu fi miidiyaalee to'annaa isaa jala jiran fayyadamuun odeeffannoo Tigraayirratti olola cimaa gaggeessaa ture. Haa ta'u malee, guddina miidiyaalee hawaasaa fi teknolojii hammayyaatiin dargaggoonni qeenxee duula propagandii kana cabsuun, hanqina paartichaa saaxiluufi yaada siyaasaa garaa garaa babal'isuu danda'aniiru. Qeenxee odeeffannoo paartichaa kan kanaan dura ture sun erga laaffatee booda, mallattoon jijjiiramaa mul'achaa jiraachuu fi hawaasni yaada bilisa ta'e akka qabaatuufi falmuuf carraan bal'achuun isaa ni ibsama.

title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
english: Renowned mountaineer and former British soldier Nirmal Purja has died in a tragic avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan. Purja, who gained international fame for his record-breaking mountain climbs, was leading a group of ten people when the accident occurred. Sadly, all members of the expedition team lost their lives in the incident.
amharic: ታዋቂው ተራራ ተወጣጣሪ እና የቀድሞ የእንግሊዝ ጦር ወታደር የሆኑት ኤርማል ፑርጃ በፓኪስታን ብሮድ ፒክ ተራራ ላይ በደረሰ የበረዶ ናዳ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በሪከርድ ሰባሪ የተራራ ጉዞዎቻቸው የሚታወቁት ፑርጃ፣ አደጋው ሲደርስ አስር ሰዎችን እየመሩ ነበር። በዚሁ አሳዛኝ አደጋ ከእርሳቸው ጋር የነበሩት የጉዞ ቡድን አባላት በሙሉ ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ታውቋል።
oromo: Gaarrreewwan baay'ee beekamaa fi waraana Biriiteenii duraanii kan turan Niirmaal Purjaa, gaara Paakistaan keessatti argamu 'Broad Peak' irratti qilleensi cabee (avalanche) isaan ajjeeseera. Purjaan, baayyee beekumsa argatanii kan turan erga gaarreen gurguddaa 14 yeroo gabaabaa keessatti baay'ee ariitiin koranii booda, yeroo balaan kun gahu namoota kudhan dursaa turan. Afuura gaarii (maddi) gadda guddaatiin, miseensonni garee isaan wajjiin turan hundi balaa kanaan lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: FIFA World Cup crisis: Who could replace Infantino as president?
english: Gianni Infantino is facing a leadership crisis at FIFA following the withdrawal of a controversial investment plan and a loss of confidence from UEFA. Significant internal resignations and allegations of misconduct have weakened his position ahead of the upcoming March presidential elections. Potential successors currently being discussed include PSG president Nasser al-Khelaifi and CONCACAF leader Victor Montagliani.
amharic: ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በፊፋ ያቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ የኢንቨስትመንት ዕቅድ በመውደቁ እና የዩኢኤፍኤ እምነት በማጣታቸው አመራራቸው አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል። ከፍተኛ አማካሪዎቻቸው ስልጣን መልቀቃቸው እና በእሳቸው ላይ የቀረቡት የሃሰት ክሶች በመጪው መጋቢት ወር በሚካሄደው የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ እንዲኖር አድርጓል። ለፕሬዝዳንትነት ሊመረጡ ይችላሉ ተብለው ከሚጠበቁት መካከል የፒኤስጂው ናሰር አል-ኬላፊ እና የኮንካካፍ መሪ ቪክቶር ሞንታግሊያኒ ይጠቀሳሉ።
oromo: ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ፣ የኢንቨስትመንት እቅዳቸው መክሸፉን ተከትሎ እና ዩኢኤፍኤ በእሳቸው ላይ ያለው እምነት መሸርሸሩን ተከትሎ የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንትነታቸው አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል። በውስጥ መስሪያ ቤታቸው በተፈጠረው አለመግባባት እና በደረሰባቸው የክስ ውርጅብኝ ሳቢያ፣ በመጋቢት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ይገጥማቸዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ለቦታው ተተኪ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ተብለው ከሚነሱ ስሞች መካከል የፒኤስጂው ናሰር አል-ኬላፊ እና የኮንካካፍ መሪ ቪክቶር ሞንታግሊያኒ ዋነኞቹ ናቸው።

title: Israeli forces kill one and destroy two hospital warehouses in Gaza strike
english: Israeli military strikes in Deir al-Balah, Gaza, resulted in the death of one person and caused significant damage to medical infrastructure. The attack destroyed two warehouses belonging to Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital and damaged two others, leading to the loss of essential medical supplies. Additionally, the hospital's outpatient clinic sustained damage during the bombardment.
amharic: በጋዛ ዲር አል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ፣ በአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል ንብረት የሆኑ ሁለት የመድኃኒት መጋዘኖች ወድመዋል። ጥቃቱ ሌሎች ሁለት መጋዘኖችንና የሆስፒታሉን የውጭ ታካሚዎች ክፍል ከፍተኛ ጉዳት በማድረሱ፣ በርካታ አስፈላጊ የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች ወድመዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Deir al-Balah kan Gaza keessatti xiyyaaraan haleellaa raawwataniin namni tokko yoo du'u, buufata fayyaa Al-Aqsa Martyrs keessatti kuusaan qorichaa lama guutummaatti barbadaa'eera. Haleellaa kanaan kuusaan qorichaa biroo lama fi bakki tajaajila dhukkubsattoota alaa miidhaa cimaa irra ga'eera; kunis qorichoonni barbaachisoon hedduun akka badaniif sababa ta'eera.

title: 'We cried instead of celebrating': War and loss shadow Gaza's top students
english: Saba Rabah, a top-ranking Palestinian student, achieved academic success in Gaza despite facing extreme hardship, including the loss of her father to the ongoing war. She studied under dire conditions, struggling with displacement, hunger, and a severe lack of basic school supplies. While her high exam results were a significant personal accomplishment, they were deeply clouded by the grief of losing her father and the difficult realities of life in the war-torn region.
amharic: ሳባ ረባህ የተባለችው የፍልስጤም ተማሪ በጋዛ በመካሄድ ላይ ባለው ጦርነት አባቷን ብታጣም፣ ከፍተኛ የትምህርት ውጤት በማምጣት የአገሪቱን የሳይንስ ዘርፍ ቀዳሚ ሆናለች። ተማሪዋ ከፍተኛ የመፈናቀል፣ የረሃብ እና የትምህርት ቁሳቁስ እጥረት ባለበት አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሆና ነው ይህንን ውጤት ያስመዘገበችው። ምንም እንኳን ውጤቷ ለሷ ትልቅ ስኬት ቢሆንም፣ የአባቷ መሞት እና በጦርነቱ ውስጥ ያለው አስከፊ የኑሮ ሁኔታ ለስኬቷ የሃዘን ጥላ አጥልቶባታል።
oromo: Barattuun Falasxiin Sabaa Rabaah jedhamtu, waraana Gaazaa keessatti abbaa ishee dhabus, qormaata biyyoolessaa irratti qabxii olaanaa galmeessisuun sadarkaa tokkoffaa baateetti. Barattuun kun qe'ee irraa buqqa'uu, beelaa fi hanqina meeshaalee barnootaa dabalatee haala ulfaataa keessatti barachuun ishee injifannoo guddaa ture. Qabxiin ishee gammachuu kan uumuu qabu ta'us, duuti abbaa ishee fi haalli waraanaa naannichaa gammachuu kana gadda cimaan akka haguugu taasiseera.

title: Vanishing forests: Why is the Philippines failing at reforestation?
english: The Philippine government's 2011 initiative to restore forests by paying locals to plant trees has largely failed to achieve its objectives. Recent investigations reveal that many reforestation targets were missed, and satellite data even shows ongoing destruction of existing forested areas. Furthermore, the program has caused concern among Indigenous groups who fear that these efforts threaten their traditional land rights and survival.
amharic: የፊሊፒንስ መንግሥት በ2011 የደን ልማትን ለማጠናከር በሀገር ውስጥ ነዋሪዎች አማካኝነት ዛፎችን ለመትከል የጀመረው ፕሮጀክት ግቦቹን ማሳካት ተስኖታል። የተደረጉ ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት ፕሮጀክቱ ከተቀመጠለት እቅድ በታች ከመውደቁም በላይ፣ ሳተላይት እንደሚያሳየው ነባር ደኖች እየጠፉ ይገኛሉ። በተጨማሪም፣ ይህ ፕሮግራም የአገሬው ተወላጆችን የመሬት ይዞታ መብት እና የኑሮ ሁኔታ አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Filippiins bara 2011 iddoo bosonaa deebisanii dhaabuuf namoota naannoo qacaruudhaan sagantaa biqiltuu dhaabuu eegale ture, garuu sagantichi galma isaa gahuu hin dandeenye. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, sagantichi karoora isaa milkeessuu hin danda'in kan ture yoo ta'u, suuraan saatalaayitiin akka ibsutti bosonni durii jiru hir'achaa jira. Kana malees, sagantichi mirga lafaa ummata naannoo (Indigenous people) irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa fi jireenya isaanii balaa irra buusuu isaa ilaalchisee yaaddoon jira.

title: Spain says migrants in Ceuta have returned to Morocco
english: Spanish authorities report that 50,000 migrants who recently entered the North African territory of Ceuta have since gone back to Morocco. There are claims suggesting that these individuals were urged to cross the border during a period marked by ongoing struggles with economic hardship. This movement highlights the complex challenges surrounding migration and the search for better prospects in Europe.
amharic: የስፔን ባለስልጣናት በሰሜን አፍሪካ ግዛት በሆነችው ሴኡታ በኩል የገቡ 50,000 ስደተኞች ወደ ሞሮኮ መመለሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ስደተኞቹ ድንበሩን እንዲያቋርጡ ይበረታቱ እንደነበር የተነገረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ድህነትና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግር ብዙ ሰዎችን ወደ አውሮፓ እንዲሰደዱ ከሚገፋፋቸው ዋና ዋና ምክንያቶች መካከል አንዱ መሆኑ ታውቋል። ይህ ክስተት በስደት እና በተሻለ የኑሮ እድል ፍለጋ ዙሪያ ያለውን ውስብስብ ችግር ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ispeen akka ibsetti, namoonni godaantota ta'an 50,000 tahan kan naannoo Se'uuta jedhamu daangaa kaaba Afrikaa keessa seenanii turan gara biyya Morookootti deebi'aniiru. Namoonni kunneen akka daangaa sana ce'an jajjabeeffamaa akka turan himameera; kunis kan ta'e hiyyummaafi rakkoon dinagdee namoota hedduu gara Awurooppaatti akka godaanan waan isaan dirqisiisuufi. Ta'iin kun rakkoo godaansaa fi fedhii jireenya gaarii barbaaduu waliin walqabatee jiru kan ibsu dha.

title: Trump mimics sound of Patriot missile interceptions
english: During a recent public appearance, Donald Trump recreated the sound of Patriot missiles intercepting targets while recounting the US military's action against Iranian missiles over Jordan. He humorously noted he needed to be precise with the number of 'bings' he made to avoid being compared to Joe Biden. This lighthearted demonstration was part of his broader commentary on military defense operations.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በተደረገ ፕሮግራም ላይ የአሜሪካ ጦር በዮርዳኖስ ላይ የኢራን ሚሳኤሎችን ሲመታ የነበረውን ድምፅ በራሳቸው አምሳያ ገልፀዋል። በሚያደርጉት ንግግር ወቅት የ'ቢንግ' ድምፅን ቁጥር በትክክል መናገር እንዳለባቸው በመጥቀስ ከጆ ባይደን ጋር እንዳይነፃፀሩ ቀልደዋል። ይህ ትርኢት የጦር መከላከያ ስራዎችን በተመለከተ የሰጡት አስተያየት አካል ነበር።
oromo: Donald Trump wayita haasaa isaanii irratti, waraanni Ameerikaa missileoota Iraan kan Yoordaanos irratti darbaman yeroo rukutu sagalee 'Patriot missile' fakkeessanii dhiyeessaniiru. Sagalee kana fakkeessuun isaanii kun, dogoggoraa fi wal-bira qabuu Joe Biden waliin akka hin godhamneef of eeggannoo gochuu isaanii ibsuuf turedha. Ibsi kunis hojii ittisa waraanaa ilaalchisee yaada isaan kennan keessatti kan dabalatedha.

title: India’s Modi says he forgives students who abused him in Cockroach protests
english: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has publicly pardoned students who insulted him during the recent Cockroach protest movement, which was sparked by a major exam leak. Although the government previously agreed to drop charges, many protesters still faced legal action and online harassment from Modi's supporters. The Prime Minister stated that these students were misguided and should be guided rather than punished or dragged through the legal system.
amharic: የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ በፈተና መፍሰስ ምክንያት በተቀሰቀሰው የኮክሮች የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴ ወቅት የተሳደቡባቸውን ተማሪዎች ይቅርታ አድርጌላቸዋለሁ ብለዋል። መንግስት ክስ እንደማይመሰርት ቃል ቢገባም፣ ብዙ ተቃዋሚዎች አሁንም በህግ እና በደጋፊዎች የሚሰነዘርባቸውን ጫና እየተቋቋሙ ይገኛሉ። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ እነዚህ ወጣቶች መንገድ የሳቱ በመሆናቸው ሊቀጡ አይገባም፣ ይልቁንም ትክክለኛውን መንገድ ማሳየት ያስፈልጋል ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Hindii Naarendiraa Moodii, qormaata biyyoolessaa irratti rakkoo uumameen walqabatee sochii mormii 'Cockroach' jedhamu irratti kan isa arrabsan barattootaaf dhiifama gochuu isaa ibseera. Mootummaan himannaa akka hin banne waadaa seeneus, mormitoonni hedduun seeraa fi doorsisa deggartoota Moodii irraa ga'uun isaan mudachaa ture. Muummeen ministirichaa barattoonni kun kan dogoggoran waan ta'eef, adabamuu mannaa karaa sirrii ta'e akka argatan gargaaruun barbaachisaa dha jedheera.

title: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
english: Spain has criticized certain European Union nations for their divisive and unfair reaction to a recent surge of migrants entering the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. While Spain quickly restored border control and addressed the crisis, countries like Italy temporarily suspended the open-border Schengen agreement in response. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez condemned these actions as politically motivated and inaccurate, noting that Ceuta is not part of the Schengen zone.
amharic: ስፔን ወደ ሴኡታ ከተማ በገቡ ስደተኞች ሳቢያ አንዳንዶች የአውሮፓ ህብረት አገራት የወሰዱትን የከፋፋይ እና ተገቢ ያልሆነ እርምጃ ኮንናለች። ስፔን የድንበር ቁጥጥሯን በፍጥነት መልሳ በመቆጣጠር ችግሩን ብትፈታም፣ እንደ ጣሊያን ያሉ አገራት ግን በምላሹ የሼንገን ነፃ የድንበር ስምምነታቸውን ለጊዜው አግደዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ እነዚህ አገራት በፖለቲካ ፍላጎት የተነሳ የተሳሳተ ውሳኔ እንደወሰዱ በመጥቀስ፣ ሴኡታ የሼንገን አካባቢ አካል እንዳልሆነች አስታውሰዋል።
oromo: Spen biyyoota Gamtaa Awurooppaa tokko tokko imaltoota gara magaalaa Se'uutaa seenaniin walqabatee tarkiiifii fudhataniin balaaleffatteetti. Spen daangaa ishee saffisaan to'annoo jala oolchitee rakkocha furteellee, biyyoonni akka Xaaliyaanii walii galtee daangaa banamaa (Schengen) yeroof dhaabaniiru. Muummeen Ministiraa Piiro Sancheez tarkiifiiwwan kunneen kaka'umsa siyaasaa fi odeeffannoo sirrii hin taaneen kan gaggeeffaman ta'uu ibsanii, Se'uutaan kutaawwan lafa Schengen keessatti hin hammatamne ta'uu yaadachiisaniiru.

title: Uefa has 'lost confidence' in Fifa leadership
english: European football's governing body, Uefa, has publicly stated it no longer trusts Fifa president Gianni Infantino. This follows the cancellation of a controversial plan to sell stakes in football competitions to private investors, which faced widespread opposition. Uefa criticized Infantino for failing to uphold his 2016 promises regarding financial transparency and development, putting his upcoming re-election campaign under significant strain.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ አስተዳዳሪ አካል የሆነው ዩኤፋ (Uefa) በፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ እምነት እንደሌለው በይፋ ገልጿል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው የእግር ኳስ ውድድሮችን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የነበረው አወዛጋቢ እቅድ መቋረጡን ተከትሎ ነው። ዩኤፋ ኢንፋንቲኖ በ2016 ለገባው የፋይናንስ ግልጽነት እና የእግር ኳስ ልማት ቃል አለመጠበቁን በመውቀስ፣ ይህም በፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Qaamni kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa bulchu Uefa, pirezidaantii Fifa Jiiyaanii Infantino irratti amantaa akka hin qabne ifatti beeksiseera. Kunis kan ta'e, morkii kubbaa miillaa gurguruuf karoorfamee turee fi mormii guddaa kaase booda Fifa karoora isaa haqachuu hordofee dha. Uefa, Infantino bara 2016 waa'ee iftoomina maallaqaa fi guddina kubbaa miillaatiif waadaa gale cabsuu isaa ceepha'eera; kunis filannoo pirezidaantummaa dhufu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa irratti uumeera.

title: Omani legend, US novice: Pakistan recovers bodies from Broad Peak
english: Pakistani rescue teams have recovered four bodies following a deadly avalanche on Broad Peak, the world's 12th highest mountain. The victims identified include prominent Omani climber Nadhira Al Harthy, experienced Nepalese mountaineer Pur Bahadur Gurung, and American climber Sarah Mallory Geis. Search efforts are ongoing for six other climbers who remain missing in the remote and dangerous mountain terrain.
amharic: በፓኪስታን በሚገኘው ብሮድ ፒክ ተራራ ላይ በደረሰው የበረዶ ናዳ አራት የተራራ መውጣት አድማስ አባላት አስከሬን ተገኝቷል። ከተገኙት መካከል የኦማኗ ናዲራ አል ሃርቲ፣ የኔፓሉ ፑር ባሃዱር ጉሩንግ እና አሜሪካዊቷ ሳራ ማሎሪ ጌይስ ይገኙበታል። በአስቸጋሪው የተራራማ ክፍል ውስጥ እስካሁን የጠፉ ስድስት ተራራ መውጣት አድማሶችን የመፈለግ ስራ ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Gaara Broad Peak jedhamu irratti balaa caba cabii mudateen duubatti, gareen fulaa barbaacha Paakistaan reeffa namoota afur argachuu danda'eera. Namoota du'an keessaa ishee Omaan irraa Nadhira Al Harthy, namni Neepaalaa Pur Bahadur Gurung fi lammii Ameerikaa Sarah Mallory Geis akka ta'an mirkanaa'eera. Yeroo ammaa kana namoota biroo jaha lafa gaaraa rakkisaa ta'e kana keessatti bade barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaatu taasifamaa jira.

title: Iran: The Making of a War
english: The documentary 'Iran: The Making of a War' examines seven decades of complex history, tracing Iran's transition from a Western-backed monarchy to an Islamic republic. It analyzes how historical events, such as the 1953 coup and the 1979 revolution, fostered deep tensions with the United States and Israel. By exploring proxy conflicts and nuclear disputes, the film illustrates how these long-standing rivalries have escalated into a dangerous confrontation with significant global consequences.
amharic: ኢራን፡ ዘ ሜኪንግ ኦፍ ኤ ዋር የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም ኢራን ከምዕራባውያን አጋርነት ወደ እስላማዊ ሪፐብሊክ የተሸጋገረችበትን የሰባት አስርት ዓመታት ታሪክ ይዳስሳል። ፊልሙ እ.ኤ.አ በ1953 የተካሄደው መፈንቅለ መንግስት እና የ1979ቱ አብዮት ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና እስራኤል ጋር ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እንዴት እንዳበላሸው ይተነትናል። በውክልና የሚደረጉ ጦርነቶችን እና የኒውክሌር ውዝግቦችን በመፈተሽ፣ እነዚህ የቆዩ አለመግባባቶች ዛሬ ለደረሱበት ዓለም አቀፍ ስጋት እንዴት እንደዳረጉ ያሳያል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'Iran: The Making of a War' jedhu seenaa waggoota torbaatamaa kanneen Iran mootummaa waggoota darban keessa keessa dabartee gara bulchiinsa Islaamummaatti jijjiiramte qorata.  Fiilmichi bu'uura waldhabdee biyyattii fi Amerikaa akkasumas Israa'el gidduu jiru, keessattuu kudeessa bara 1953 fi jijjiirama siyaasaa bara 1979 irratti xiyyeeffata. Walitti bu'iinsi gidduu kanaa fi falmii niwukilaraa qorachuun, rakkoon kun yeroo ammaa akkamitti gara balaa idil-addunyaa fi naannawaatti akka guddachuu danda'e ibsa.

title: Infantino’s World Cup crisis: UEFA has ‘lost confidence’ in FIFA leadership
english: UEFA has formally declared a loss of trust in FIFA's leadership following President Gianni Infantino's controversial attempt to sell minority stakes in World Cup events to private investors. Although Infantino scrapped the proposal due to intense opposition, UEFA criticized the lack of transparency behind the project and demanded accountability for those involved. European football officials are now calling for a more open approach to managing global football resources to ensure the sport's development remains the primary focus.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡትን አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ ተከትሎ፣ የUEFA አመራር በፊፋ ላይ እምነት እንደሌለው በይፋ ገልጿል። ኢንፋንቲኖ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ በመግጠሙ ዕቅዱን ቢሰርዝም፣ UEFA የዕቅዱን ምስጢራዊነት በመተቸት በጉዳዩ ላይ ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር ጠይቋል። የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበር አሁን ላይ የዓለም እግር ኳስ ሃብት አያያዝ የበለጠ ግልጽ እንዲሆን እና የጨዋታውን እድገት ብቻ ማዕከል እንዲያደርግ እየወተወተ ነው።
oromo: UEFA, dura ta’aan FIFA Gianni Infantino qooda tapha waancaa addunyaa qaama dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatee ture hordofee, gaggeessummaa FIFA irratti amantii akka dhabe ibseera. Infantino mormii guddaa hordofee karooricha haquus, UEFA karoorichi iftoomina kan hin qabne ta’uu fi qaamni itti gaafatamuu qabu akka jiraatu gaafateera. Waldaan kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa amma qabeenyi kubbaa miillaa addunyaa irra caalaatti iftoomina akka qabaatu fi xiyyeeffannoon guddaan guddina ispoortichaa irratti akka ta’u gaafachaa jira.

title: Iranian Kurdish parties in Iraq face a delicate balance amid Iran attacks
english: Iranian Kurdish political and military groups stationed in northern Iraq are currently facing intense pressure and direct attacks from Iran following the regional escalation of the conflict. While leaders from the U.S. and Israel have considered supporting these factions to challenge the Iranian government, the groups emphasize they are operating independently. Despite the danger and increased military targeting of their bases, these Kurdish organizations continue to maintain networks and influence within Iran.
amharic: በኢራቅ የኩርድ ክልል የሚገኙ የኢራን ኩርድ ተቃዋሚ ቡድኖች የክልሉ ጦርነት ከተቀሰቀሰ ወዲህ በኢራን የከባድ ጥቃቶች ኢላማ ሆነዋል። ምንም እንኳን አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል እነዚህን ቡድኖች በመደገፍ የኢራንን መንግስት ለመቃወም ቢፈልጉም፣ ቡድኖቹ ግን በራሳቸው አቅም እየተንቀሳቀሱ መሆናቸውን ይገልጻሉ። በኢራን ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች አባሎቻቸው ቢሞቱም፣ ድርጅቶቹ በኢራን ውስጥ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ እና ወታደራዊ መዋቅር ለማስቀጠል እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: gareewwan siyaasaa fi waraana KurdiIraan kan naannoo KurdiIraaq keessa qubatan, waraanni naannichaa erga eegalee as weerara cimaa fi haleellaa kallattii Iraan irraa isaan mudachaa jira. Mootummoonni Ameerikaa fi Israa'el gareewwan kana gargaaruun mootummaa Iraan irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaada qabanus, gareewwan kun garuu of danda'anii akka socho'an ibsu. Haleellaa raajii fi misaa'elaa gareewwan isaanirratti gaggeeffamuun lubbuun namootaa darbus, dhaabbileen kun humni isaanii Iraan keessatti akka hin dhaamneef tattaaffii godhaa jiru.

title: Beneath Tunisia’s silence, public anger simmers
english: Five years after President Kais Saied consolidated power, Tunisia is facing significant unrest driven by a worsening economy, frequent power outages, and a crackdown on political dissent. Thousands of protesters recently gathered to challenge his increasingly authoritarian rule, highlighting the decline of democratic freedoms since the 2011 revolution. Meanwhile, the government's failure to address critical infrastructure issues and ongoing environmental disasters has further fueled public frustration.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድ ስልጣንን ከተቆጣጠሩ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ቱኒዚያ በኢኮኖሚ ውድቀት፣ በተደጋጋሚ የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ እና በፖለቲካዊ ጭቆና የተነሳ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟታል። የቅርብ ጊዜዎቹ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች የፕሬዝዳንቱን አምባገነናዊ አካሄድ እና ከ2011ቱ አብዮት ወዲህ የዲሞክራሲ ስርዓቱ መዳከሙን ያሳያሉ። መንግስት መሰረታዊ የመሰረተ ልማት ችግሮችን መፍታት አለመቻሉ እና በሀገሪቱ እየተከሰቱ ያሉ የተፈጥሮ አደጋዎች የህዝቡን ቁጣ አባብሰዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Kais Saa'iid aangoo erga qabatanii waggaa shan booda, biyyi Tunisiyaa rakkoo dinagdee, kutannoo elektirikii fi cunqursa siyaasaa cimaan mudattee jirti. Hiriirtonni kumaan lakkaa'aman mootummaa isaa kan gara amba-gaddummaa jijjiiramaa jiru mormuun, sirni dimokraasii kan bara 2011 irraa eegale lafa qabachuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Mootummaan rakkoo bu'uuraa furuu dadhabuu fi balaan uumamaa biyyattii mudate dallansuu uummataa daran dabalee jira.

title: Israeli drone attack kills two Palestinians in Gaza
english: Two Palestinians were killed in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of Gaza following an Israeli drone strike. This incident is part of a broader escalation that has resulted in the deaths of seven people across the region within the last two days. Medical officials confirmed the casualties from these recent military operations.
amharic: በጋዛ በሼክ ራድዋን አካባቢ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ባለፉት ሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች የሰባት ሰዎች ሞት ተረጋግጧል። የጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር እና የሆስፒታል ምንጮች ይህንን መረጃ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Gaazaatti argamtu Sheikh Radwan jedhamtutti, haleellaa xiyyaara maleeyyuu (drone) Israa'el raawwattee kanaan lammiileen Falasxiin lama ajjeefamaniiru. Haleellaa kana dabalatee, guyyoota lamaan darban keessa guutuu Gaazaatti namoonni torba ajjeefamuun isaanii gabaafameera. Ministirri fayyaa fi ogeeyyiin fayyaa lakkoofsa namoota du'anii kana mirkaneessaniiru.

title: After Israel killed her three sons, she found hope in a newborn. Then he was killed too
english: Fatima Nofal, a Palestinian mother living in Gaza, has suffered the tragic loss of all four of her sons due to Israeli airstrikes. After three of her children were killed in 2023, she found a glimmer of hope with the birth of her son Zaid in 2025. Tragically, Zaid was also killed when an airstrike hit their home in July 2026, leaving the grieving mother to face further displacement and trauma.
amharic: በጋዛ የምትኖር ፋጢማ ኖፋል የተባለች እናት በአራት የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች አራቱንም ወንዶች ልጆቿን አጥታለች። እ.ኤ.አ በ2023 ሶስት ልጆቿን ካጣች በኋላ በ2025 በወለደችው ዘይድ የተባለ ልጅ ተስፋ አድርጋ ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ዘይድ በሐምሌ 2026 በተፈጸመ ሌላ የአየር ጥቃት ህይወቱ በማለፉ እናትየው ዳግመኛ ከፍተኛ ሀዘንና መፈናቀል ውስጥ ወድቃለች።
oromo: Haati Palastinuu kan taate Faatimaa Nofal, weerara qilleensaatti Israa'el raawwatte keessa ilmaan ishee afran hunda dhabdeetti. Bara 2023 ilmaan ishee sadii erga dhabdee booda, ilmi ishee Zaayd bara 2025 yeroo dhalatu abdii guddaa argatte turte. Garuu, Ji'a Adoolessaa 2026 manni isaanii yeroo rukutamu Zaaydis lubbuun isaa darbuun, haati kun gaddaafi godaansa hamaa keessa akka seentu taasiseera.

title: Why are Kurdish groups in Iraq being attacked amid the US-Iran flare-up?
english: Amid ongoing tensions between the US and Iran, Iranian forces are launching strikes against Iranian Kurdish opposition groups stationed in northern Iraq. Iran accuses these groups of being part of a US-Israeli plot to destabilize the country, although the Kurdish factions strongly deny these claims. These attacks highlight Iran's strategy of eliminating perceived external threats while navigating the broader regional conflict.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ውጥረት ሳቢያ፣ የኢራን ኃይሎች በሰሜን ኢራቅ የሚገኙ የኢራን ኩርድ ተቃዋሚ ቡድኖችን እያጠቁ ይገኛሉ። ኢራን እነዚህ ቡድኖች አገሪቱን ለማተራመስ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል የተጠነሰሰ ሴራ አካል ናቸው ብላ ብትከስም፣ የኩርድ ቡድኖቹ ግን ክሱን አጥብቀው አስተባብለዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የኢራን መንግሥት በክልሉ ካለው ግጭት ጎን ለጎን ውጫዊ ስጋት ናቸው ብሎ የሚያምናቸውን አካላት ለማስወገድ ያለውን ስልት ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Waliigaltee dhabuun Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti uumame hordofee, humnoonni Iraan gareewwan mormituu Kurdiis kan biyya Iraanii kanneen kaaba Iraaq keessa qubatan irratti weerara gaggeessaa jiru. Iraan gareewwan kunneen biyyattii burjaajessuuf karoora Ameerikaa fi Israa'el qopheessan keessatti hirmaachaa jiru jechuun yoo himattu, gareewwan Kurdiis garuu himata kana guutummaatti haalaniiru. Weerari kun mootummaan Iraan walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti sodaachisaa dha jedhee kan amanu gareewwan alaa balleessuuf tarsiimoo itti fayyadamaa jiru agarsiisa.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia is undergoing a significant political shift as proposed constitutional reforms move away from the country's traditional power structure. Amhara political identity, which has historically been centered on state influence, now faces a transition toward the periphery due to the Prosperity Party's new focus on demographic majoritarianism. By basing political representation on regional population size rather than equal party power, the current system is fundamentally changing how influence is distributed across Ethiopia.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ በታቀደው የሕገ መንግሥት ማሻሻያ አማካኝነት ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ እያደረገች ነው። በአገሪቱ ማዕከላዊ የፖለቲካ ስልጣን ላይ ትልቅ ሚና የነበራቸው የአማራ የፖለቲካ ኃይሎች፣ የብልጽግና ፓርቲ በሕዝብ ብዛት ላይ የተመሠረተ የስልጣን ክፍፍል በመተግበሩ ወደ ጎን የመገለል ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል። ይህ አዲስ አሠራር ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን እኩል የወካይ ፓርቲዎች ስምምነት በመተካት የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ በህዝብ ቁጥር እንዲወሰን እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Itoophiyaan sirna ishee durii jijjiiruuf yaadamee dhihaateen jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa keessa jirti. Paartiin Badhaadhinaa bakka bu'iinsa siyaasaa baay'ina ummataa irratti waan hundeesseef, kunis humnoota siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti adeemsaafi raayyaa aangootti jijjiirama bu'uuraa fidaa jira.

title: FIFA World Cup plan fallout: AFC reacts as Infantino scraps investment push
english: FIFA has officially dropped its controversial plan to sell a 20 percent stake in its World Cup operations to private investors after facing strong resistance from regional football confederations. The Asian Football Confederation (AFC) welcomed this decision, noting that they had been blindsided by the initial proposal. Moving forward, the AFC has called for more transparency, urging FIFA to engage in meaningful dialogue with all stakeholders before making significant changes to the sport.
amharic: ፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ውድድሮችን በከፊል ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ አቅዶ የነበረውን አወዛጋቢ ውሳኔ ከክልላዊ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት በገጠመው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ምክንያት ሰርዞታል። የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ይህንን ውሳኔ በደስታ የተቀበለ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲል በነበረው ሂደት ላይ መረጃ ሳይሰጠው በድንገት እንደተገረመ ገልጿል። ወደፊትም ፊፋ በስፖርቱ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ ከማምጣቱ በፊት ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር ግልጽ እና ሁሉን አቀፍ ውይይት እንዲያደርግ አሳስቧል።
oromo: FIFA karoora isaa kan World Cup irraa harka 20 dhuunfaatti gurgurachuuf qabatee ture, mormii guddaa gamtaa kubbaa miilaa naannolee irraa dhufeen booda haqeera. Gamtaan Kubbaa Miilaa Eeshiyaa (AFC) murtee kana kan simate yoo ta'u, karoorichi dursanii isaan hin mariisifne jechuun mormii isaa ibseera. Fuuldurattis, FIFA jijjiirama guddaa kamiyyuu osoo hin godhin dura, qaamolee dhimmi ilaallatu hunda waliin marii ifa ta'e akka taasisu AFC gaafateera.

title: Houthis deny planning to charge ships passing through Red Sea
english: The Houthi group has officially refuted recent media claims suggesting they intend to collect tolls from commercial vessels navigating the Baab el-Mandeb strait. They clarified that no such policy has been established and emphasized that ships can still travel through the area without any charges. This statement serves to correct previous reports regarding potential financial levies on maritime traffic in the region.
amharic: የሁቲ ቡድን በባብ ኤል-ማንዴብ ስትሬት የሚያልፉ የንግድ መርከቦች ክፍያ እንደሚጠይቁ የወጡትን ዘገባዎች በይፋ አስተባብለዋል። ቡድኑ ምንም አይነት የክፍያ ውሳኔ እንዳልተላለፈ እና መርከቦች አሁንም በነጻነት ማለፍ እንደሚችሉ ገልጿል። ይህ መግለጫ በባህር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ቀረጥ ስለመጣል የተሰራጨውን የተሳሳተ መረጃ ለማስተካከል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gareen Hutiin gabaasawwan markaboota daldalaa kanneen 'Baab el-Mandeb' keessa darban irraa kaffaltii barbaadu jedhanii ba'an haaleera. Humni kun murtiin akkasii hin darbe jedhee fi markaboonni ammas bilisaan darbuu akka danda'an ibseera. Ibsi kun oduu kaffaltii waliin wal qabatee tamsa'ee ture sirreessuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Israeli forces arrest seven, including two teens, in West Bank
english: Israeli military forces conducted raids across the occupied West Bank, resulting in the detention of at least seven Palestinians. Among those taken into custody were two sixteen-year-old minors captured during separate operations near Tubas and Bethlehem. These arrests are part of ongoing security activities within the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ባደረጉት ወረራ ቢያንስ ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ከተያዙት መካከል በቱባስ እና በቤተልሔም አካባቢ የተያዙ ሁለት የ16 ዓመት ታዳጊዎች ይገኙበታል። እነዚህ እስሮች በክልሉ ውስጥ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ የጸጥታ ኦፕሬሽኖች አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Humnootiin waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-gamaa (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii fudhataniin palastinoota torba ol ta'an to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Namoota qabaman kana keessatti dargaggoota umuriin isaanii waggaa 16 ta'an lama kan argaman yoo ta'u, isaanis magaalaa Tubas fi Beeteliheem biratti qabaman. Qabxiin kun hojiilee nageenyaa naannichatti geggeeffamaa jiran keessaa kan maddan dha.

title: Fifa scraps controversial World Cup investment plan
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has officially canceled a contentious plan to sell stakes in major tournaments to private investors following intense backlash from various football confederations. The proposal faced strong opposition from European and other regional governing bodies, who feared the move would negatively impact the sport's future. This decision leaves Infantino under significant pressure as he approaches his re-election bid next year.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለዓለም ዋንጫ ውድድሮች የግል ባለሀብቶችን ለማሳተፍ አቅደውት የነበረውን አወዛጋቢ እቅድ በይፋ ሰርዘዋል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ከተለያዩ አህጉራዊ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ እነርሱም የእግር ኳስ ስፖርትን የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል በሚል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሚቀጥለው ዓመት ለሚካሄደው ምርጫ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ባሉት ፕሬዝዳንት ኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infaantiinoo, dorgommiwwan gurguddoo irratti dhaabbilee dhuunfaa hirmaachisuuf karoorfatanii turan haquu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Karoorri kun gamtaa kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessaa fi ardiiwwan garaa garaa irraa mormii cimaa kan mudate yoo ta'u, isaanis tarkaanichi fuulduratti kubbaa miilaa irratti miidhaa geessisa jedhanii yaaddoo qabu turan. Murteen kun pireezidaant Infaantiinoo bara dhufu filannoo irra deebiin dorgomuuf karoorfatanii jiran irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
english: A prominent Israeli settler at the Havat Gilad outpost recently defended violent attacks on nearby Palestinian villages as a form of retaliation for the death of a security guard. During an interview with the BBC, he expressed extreme, discriminatory views, suggesting that a single Jewish life is worth millions of Palestinian lives. This incident highlights the ongoing tensions and escalating violence occurring within the occupied West Bank.
amharic: በሀቫት ጊላድ ሰፈራ የሚኖር አንድ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪ በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ የፍልስጤም መንደሮች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት የበቀል እርምጃ በማለት አፅድቆታል። ለቢቢሲ በሰጠው ቃለ ምልልስ አንድ የአይሁድ ሕይወት በሚሊዮን ከሚቆጠሩ የፍልስጤም ሕይወት ጋር እኩል እንደሆነ በመግለጽ አክራሪ እና ዘረኛ አስተያየቶችን ሰንዝሯል። ይህ ክስተት በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭትና የጥቃት ሁኔታ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Buufata Havat Gilad kan jiraatu jiraataan Israa'el tokko, gandoota Falastii rixoota ollaa isaa irratti haleellaa raawwatame tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu jechuun ittiseera. BBC wajjin gaaffii fi deebii erga taasisee booda, jireenyi Yihuudii tokko jireenya Falastii miiliyoona hedduu caala jechuun yaada jibbinsa qabu ibseera. Taateen kun walitti bu'iinsa fi haleellaa naannoo West Bank keessatti dabalaa jiru kan mul'isuudha.

title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill at least nine, Ukraine officials say
english: Russian ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv have resulted in at least nine deaths and dozens of injuries, causing significant damage to residential buildings. The escalation of these air strikes has renewed calls from President Zelensky for more advanced air defense interceptors. Meanwhile, discussions remain ongoing regarding the potential for Ukraine to domestically produce US Patriot missiles to help defend against these ongoing threats.
amharic: በኪየቭ ከተማ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። የጥቃቱ መጠናከር ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ተጨማሪ የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች እንደሚያስፈልጉ እንዲጠይቁ አስገድዷቸዋል። ዩክሬን እነዚህን ሚሳይሎች ለመከላከል የሚያስችሉ የፓትሪዮት ሚሳይሎችን በራሷ ሀገር ለማምረት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ውይይት እያደረገች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kiyiv irratti waraana miisaayiliin gaggeesseen lubbuun namoota sagalii darbee, hedduunis madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan hammate yoo ta’u, Pireezidaant Zelenskiin ittisa qilleensaa gahaa akka barbaadan ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Yukreen miisaayilii 'Patriot' jedhaman biyya ishee keessatti oomishuudhaan of ittisuuf mootummaa Ameerikaa waliin marii irratti argamti.

title: Protesters detained at rally in support of Pakistan-administered Kashmir
english: Police in Lahore, Pakistan, arrested multiple protesters during a demonstration held in support of Pakistan-administered Kashmir. The rally took place amid reports from a restricted activist organization that recent regional election conflicts have claimed at least 30 lives. Authorities moved to detain participants as tensions continue to rise regarding the volatile region.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ላሆር ከተማ፣ በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር ድጋፍ ሰልፍ ሲያደርጉ የነበሩ በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎች በፖሊስ ተይዘዋል። ይህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ የተካሄደው በአካባቢው ምርጫ ወቅት በተከሰቱ ግጭቶች ቢያንስ 30 ሰዎች መገደላቸውን አንድ ታጋድ የተባለ ቡድን በዘገበበት ወቅት ነው። ባለስልጣናት ሰልፈኞችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉት በክልሉ ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ነው።
oromo: Poolisiin magaalaa Laahor kan biyya Paakistaan, namoota Kaashmiir kan Paakistaaniin buluuf deeggarsa argisiisaa turan hedduu hidheera. Hiriirri kun kan ta'e, gareen dhaabbileen kabajamuu dhaban tokko filannoo naannoo darbe keessa walitti bu'iinsa uumameen namoonni 30 ol du'uu isaanii ibsaa turanitti. Mootummaan hiriirtoota kanneen hidhe, naannicha keessatti jeequmsi fi waldhabdeen dabalaa waan dhufeef.

title: US drops charges against Olympian for damage to Reflecting Pool
english: The United States government has officially dropped all legal charges against Olympian David Hearn regarding damage caused to the Washington DC Reflecting Pool. Prosecutors decided to dismiss the case after uncovering new information. Investigations revealed that the damage was caused by improper installation by a contractor rather than acts of vandalism.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኦሎምፒክ አትሌቱ ዳዊት ሄርን ላይ በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በሚገኘው የሪፍሌክቲንግ ኩሬ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰሃል በሚል ቀርቦ የነበረውን ክስ በይፋ አቋርጧል። አቃቤ ህጉ አዲስ ማስረጃዎችን ካገኘ በኋላ ክሱን ለመተው ወስኗል። የተገኘው መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው ጉዳቱ የደረሰው በሆን ተብሎ በተፈጸመ ጥፋት ሳይሆን በኮንትራክተሩ በተሳሳተ የግንባታ ስራ መሆኑ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa himata oolompikii atileetii Deevid Heern irratti 'Reflecting Pool' Washington DC keessatti argamu irratti miidhaa geessise jedhamee dhiyaatee ture bal'inaan haqee jira. Abbaan alangaa ragaa haaraa erga argatee booda himaticha gadi dhiisuuf murteesse. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, miidhaan kun kan ga'e miidhaa qaqqabsiisuuf yaadamee osoo hin taane, hojiin dhaabbata ijaarsa tokkoo sirrii ta'ee waan hin hojjetamneef akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera.

title: Kuwaiti army says air defence systems intercepting 'hostile drones'
english: The Kuwaiti military has reported that its air defense systems are actively intercepting hostile drones following recent Iranian aggression. Authorities have clarified that any loud explosions heard by residents are caused by these defensive operations. The public is advised to remain calm and follow all official safety protocols issued by security personnel.
amharic: የኩዌት ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከአየር ላይ የሚመጡ የጠላት ድሮኖችን የመከላከል ስራ እየሰራ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የሰሙት የፍንዳታ ድምፆች የመከላከያ ስርዓቱ እነዚህን ድሮኖች ሲያከሽፍ የተፈጠሩ መሆናቸውን የኩዌት ጦር ገልጿል። ህዝቡ ከስልጣን አካላት የሚወጡ የደህንነት መመሪያዎችን እንዲከተል ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
