Ummanni qajeelfamoota nageenyaa qaamolee mootummaa irraa kennaman akka hordofan hubachiisaniiru.

title: UKMTO says explosion near tanker off Oman reported
english: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported two separate maritime incidents involving tankers near the coast of Oman. In one event, a crew observed an explosion near their ship without sustaining any damage, while another vessel suffered engine room damage after being hit by an unknown object. Authorities are currently monitoring these security threats in the region.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽንስ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በሁለት የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቋል። በአንደኛው ክስተት መርከበኞች በመርከባቸው አቅራቢያ ፍንዳታ ቢመለከቱም ምንም ጉዳት አልደረሰም፤ በሌላኛው ክስተት ግን አንድ መርከብ ባልታወቀ ነገር ተመታች የሞተር ክፍል ጉዳት ደርሶባታል። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው ያለውን የባህር ደህንነት ሁኔታ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hojii Daldala Galaana UK kan ta'e (UKMTO) qarqara galaana Omaanitti dooniiwwan boba'aa fe'an lama irratti rakkoo uumame ibseera. Iccitii tokkoon, dooniin tokko bakka itti boba'inni dhohe argitus miidhaan irra hin geenye, garuu dooniin biraa meeshaa hin beekamneen rukutamtee kutaan maashinii ishee miidhameera. Qaamoleen naga eegumsaa naannicha keessatti nageenya galaanichaa hordofaa jiru.

title: Israeli forces raid dozens of Palestinian homes in Nablus
english: Early Saturday morning, Israeli military forces conducted a widespread operation in the Palestinian town of 'Asira ash Shamaliya, located north of Nablus. Soldiers broke into numerous homes and gathered many local residents into a single property. This building was temporarily converted into a site for military questioning.
amharic: ቅዳሜ እለቱን በማለዳ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከናብሉስ በስተሰሜን በሚገኘው የአሲራ አሽ ሻማሊያ ከተማ በበርካታ የፍልስጤማውያን መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል። ወታደሮቹ ብዙ ነዋሪዎችን ከአንድ ቤት ውስጥ ሰብስበው ህንጻውን ለጊዜያዊ የጥያቄ ማዕከልነት ተጠቅመውበታል።
oromo: Ganama Sanbata ganama, loltoonni Israa'el magaalaa Naablus kaabaatti argamtu 'Asira ash Shamaliyaa keessatti manneen warra Falasxiin hedduu cabsuun seenaaniiru. Loltoonni kun jiraattota hedduu mana tokko keessatti walitti qabuun, bakka sana gara bakka gaaffii fi deebii yerootti jijjiirataniiru.

title: Morning recap
english: Tensions are escalating as President Trump threatens Iran with significant military action, prompting Tehran to warn of retaliatory strikes against US and Israeli energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has plummeted following threats from both the US and Iran, while a projectile recently damaged a tanker near Oman. In other developments, despite a newly announced Gaza peace deal involving Hamas disarmament, regional instability continues with ongoing Israeli military strikes.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ በማስፈራራታቸው ውጥረቱ ተባብሷል፣ ይህም ኢራን በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል የኃይል ማመንጫዎች ላይ የአጸፋ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ እንድታስጠነቅቅ አድርጓል። በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል በተፈጠረው አለመግባባት ምክንያት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ የሚደረግ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የቀነሰ ሲሆን፣ በኦማን አቅራቢያም አንድ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ ሀማስ ትጥቅ እንዲፈታ ስምምነት ቢደረግም፣ በጋዛ ላይ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Prezidaant Traamp Iraan irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa akka fudhatan doorsisuun isaanitiin walqabatee, Iraanis bu'uuraalee misoomaa Amerikaa fi Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii deebii akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteetti. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaan walqabatee sochiin dooniiwwan dhangala'aa gara galaana Hormuz jiru hir'achuu fi dooniin tokko immoo Omaan biratti miidhamuu gabaasameera. Gama biraatiin, Hamas hidhannoo akka hiiku waliigaltee irra ga'amee utuu jiruu, lola Israa'el fi Gaazaa gidduutti geggeeffamaa jiruun lubbuun namootaa darbuun ibsameera.

title: Israeli settlers desecrate Palestinian cemetery in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers damaged gravestones in a Palestinian cemetery located near Tal village in the occupied West Bank. During the incident, local residents reported that Israeli military forces protected the marchers and used tear gas against Palestinians. This act of vandalism has drawn criticism for its disrespect toward the burial site.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ የታል መንደር አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ እስራኤላዊያን ሰፋሪዎች የፍልስጤማውያንን መቃብር አውድመዋል። የዓይን እማኞች እንደገለጹት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰልፉን በመጠበቅ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ አስለቃሽ ጭስ ተጠቅመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በሟቾች መቃብር ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ውግዘት ገጥሞታል።
oromo: Godina waldhaggeetti (West Bank) ganda Taali jedhamu biratti, qubattoonni Israa'el qabxiiwwan awwaala warra Falasxiin irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni Israa'el hiriicha eegaa turuu fi Falasxiinota irratti gaazii imimmaaniin guutu fayyadamuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gochi kun awwaala namoota du'anii irratti miidhaa waan geessiseef, mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Peru’s ex-president Humala released after conviction overturned
english: Peru's Constitutional Court has overturned the 15-year money laundering conviction of former President Ollanta Humala, leading to his release from prison. The court ruled that the charges were invalid because the actions Humala was accused of did not legally constitute money laundering at the time of his presidential campaigns. Humala had been previously sentenced for receiving illegal funds from the Brazilian construction company Odebrecht and the Venezuelan government.
amharic: የፔሩ ሕገ-መንግስታዊ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ኦላንታ ሁማላ በገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል የተጣለባቸውን የ15 ዓመት እስራት በመሻር ከእስር እንዲፈቱ ወስኗል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ሁማላ የተከሰሱበት ድርጊት በወቅቱ በነበረው ህግ የገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል እንደማይቆጠር በመግለጽ የፍርድ ሂደቱ ውድቅ እንዲሆን አድርጓል። ሁማላ ከብራዚላዊቷ የግንባታ ኩባንያ ኦዴብሬክት እና ከቬንዙዌላ መንግስት ህገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል በሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸው ነበር።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa biyya Peeruu, pirezidaantii duraanii Ollanta Humala irratti yakka qarshii seeraan alaa dhiquun adabbii waggaa 15 irra ga'ee ture akka haqamu murteessuun hidhaa akka gadhiifamu taasiseera. Mana murtichaa akka ibsetti, himannaan irratti dhiyaatee ture yeroo sana seera biyyattiitiin yakka akkasii akka hin taane waan bira ga'eef murtiin dura ture kufaa ta'eera. Humala kan hidhaman, kampanii ijaarsa biyya Biraazil Odebrecht fi mootummaa Veenezueelaa irraa deeggarsa maallaqaa seeraan alaa fudhataniiru jedhamanii turan.

title: Yemen’s Houthis deny plan to charge ships transiting Red Sea
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels have officially rejected claims that they intend to start charging vessels for traveling through the Red Sea. They stated that the passage remains free and warned shipping companies against paying unauthorized parties demanding money. This announcement follows media reports suggesting the group was considering imposing fees on this critical global trade route.

Gabaasni kun kan dhufe, gareen kun karaa daldala idil-addunyaa kan ta'e daandii galaana 'Bab al-Mandeb' irratti kaffaltii gaafachuuf karoorfateera jedhamee gabaasamee booda.

title: Is Israel really ready to withdraw from Gaza?
english: A recent disarmament agreement between Hamas and the United States has proposed an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza in exchange for the surrender of weaponry. However, the Israeli government remains hesitant, insisting that no troops will leave until Hamas is fully disarmed, despite optimistic claims from President Trump. The proposal faces significant opposition within Israel, where public sentiment and many politicians favor continued military presence and the potential establishment of settlements rather than returning control to Palestinians.
amharic: በሃማስ እና በአሜሪካ መካከል የተደረሰው የትጥቅ መፍታት ስምምነት፣ እስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያዎቿን እንድታስረክብ እና ከጋዛ እንድትወጣ ይጠይቃል። ይሁን እንጂ የእስራኤል መንግስት ሃማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ከጋዛ እንደማይወጣ በመግለጽ ስምምነቱን በጥርጣሬ እየተመለከተው ነው። በሌላ በኩል፣ በአብዛኛዎቹ የእስራኤል ፖለቲከኞች እና ህዝብ ዘንድ የጋዛን አካባቢ መልቀቅ ተቀባይነት የሌለው በመሆኑ፣ በምትኩ ወታደራዊ ይዞታቸውን ለማስቀጠል እና የአይሁድ ሰፈራዎችን ለመገንባት ፍላጎት አላቸው።
oromo: waliigalteen hidhannoo hiikkachuu kan Haamaas fi Ameerikaa gidduutti godhame, Israa'el meeshaa waraanaa hiikkachuu fi Gaazaa irraa akka baatu gaafata. Haa ta'u malee, mootummaan Israa'el Haamaas guutummaatti hidhannoo hiikkachuu baannaan Gaazaa gad-lakkisuu akka hin danda'in ibsuun, waliigaltee kana mormaa jira. Gama biraatiin, Israa'el keessatti yaanni ummataa fi siyaas-nassoonni hedduun Gaazaa gadi-lakkisuu diduun, bakka sana waraanaan to'achuu fi qubata Israa'elootaa (settlements) ijaaruuf fedhii qabu.

title: Liberia’s kush crisis: The hidden trade behind a generation at risk
english: Liberia is facing a severe public health crisis as a cheap, highly addictive synthetic drug called kush spreads among its youth. This addiction has caused significant social harm, leading many young people to drop out of school, become homeless, and suffer from family estrangement. Despite the government declaring a drug emergency, families struggle to find effective, affordable treatment options for their loved ones.
amharic: ላይቤሪያ 'ኩሽ' በተባለ ርካሽ እና ሱስ አስያዥ አደንዛዥ ዕፅ መስፋፋት የተነሳ ከባድ የህዝብ ጤና ቀውስ ገጥሟታል። ይህ ሱስ በወጣቶች መካከል ትምህርታቸውን እንዲያቋርጡ፣ ቤት አልባ እንዲሆኑ እና ከቤተሰቦቻቸው እንዲራራቁ በማድረግ ማህበራዊ ቀውስ እየፈጠረ ይገኛል። መንግስት ጉዳዩን አስቸኳይ የጤና ቀውስ ብሎ ቢያውጅም፣ በችግሩ የተጎዱ ቤተሰቦች ለተጎጂዎች ተገቢውን የህክምና እርዳታ ለማግኘት ከፍተኛ ችግር እየገጠማቸው ነው።
oromo: Layibeeriyaan 'kush' jedhamuun kan beekamu qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu kan gatiin isaa raasaa fi qaama namaa salphaatti qabatu sababa guddaa ta'eef rakkoo fayyaa hawaasaa cimaa keessa jirti. Wal-qabatee kanaan, dargaggoonni baay'een barumsa isaanii akka dhiisan, man-maleeyyii akka ta'an fi maatii isaanii irraa akka gargar ba'an ta'eera. Mootummaan rakkoo kana akka ariifachiisaa ta'etti labsuu isaa iyyuu, maatiin miidhaan irra ga'e kun qoricha gahaa fi tajaajila fayyaa walitti fufiinsa qabu argachuuf rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Russian missile attack kills three in Ukraine’s Kyiv
english: A Russian missile strike on Kyiv has resulted in the deaths of three individuals and left 15 others injured, including two teenagers. The attack caused significant damage and fires across several city districts, prompting emergency responders to conduct ongoing rescue operations. This incident highlights Ukraine's struggle to defend against ballistic missiles due to a critical shortage of air defense systems.
amharic: በዩክሬን ዋና ከተማ ኪየቭ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የሮኬት ጥቃት ሦስት ሰዎች መሞታቸውና 15 ሰዎች ደግሞ መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። ጥቃቱ በተለያዩ የከተማዋ ክፍሎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳትና የእሳት ቃጠሎ ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች የነፍስ አድን ስራቸውን አሁንም ቀጥለዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የዩክሬን የአየር መከላከያ ስርዓት ውስንነት በመኖሩ ምክንያት ለተደጋጋሚ የሮኬት ጥቃቶች ተጋላጭ መሆኗን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa magaalaa guddoo Yukreen, Kiyiv irratti rookeetii ergeen namoota sadii yoo ajjeesu, dargaggoota lama dabalatee namoota 15 miidheera. Haleellaan kun kutaalee magaalaa hedduu keessatti mancaatii guddaa fi ibidda kan kaase yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa hojii lubba baraarsummaa itti fufanii jiru. Miidhaan kun, Yukreen sirna ittisa qilleensaa gahaa hin qabne irraa kan ka'e haleellaa rookeetii kanaaf saaxilamuu ishee agarsiisa.

title: HRF says Dutch took no action against Israeli soldier despite criminal complaint
english: The Hind Rajab Foundation recently filed a formal complaint with Dutch authorities against Israeli soldier Leon Khlebnikov, accusing him of war crimes and genocide in Gaza. The organization claims that Khlebnikov shared social media footage celebrating the destruction of civilian infrastructure, including a school in Rafah. Despite these serious allegations, the foundation reports that the Dutch government failed to take any action against him during his visit to the country.
amharic: የሂንድ ራጃብ ፋውንዴሽን እስራኤላዊው ወታደር ሊዮን ክሌብኒኮቭ በጋዛ የጦር ወንጀል እና የዘር ማጥፋት ፈጽሟል በሚል በኔዘርላንድ ባለስልጣናት ላይ ክስ አቅርቦ ነበር። ፋውንዴሽኑ ክሌብኒኮቭ በትምህርት ቤት ላይ ያደረሰውን ጥቃት ጨምሮ የሲቪል መሰረተ ልማቶችን ሲያወድም የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መለጠፉን ገልጿል። ሆኖም በኔዘርላንድ በቆየበት ወቅት ባለስልጣናቱ በወታደሩ ላይ ምንም አይነት እርምጃ እንዳልወሰዱ ፋውንዴሽኑ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Hind Rajab Foundation loltuu Israa'el Leon Khlebnikov himannaa yakka waraanaa fi fixiinsa sanyii Gaazaatti raawwate jedhee mootummaa Neezarlaandiitti dhiyeesseera. Dhaabbatichi akka jedhutti, Khlebnikov miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti manneen barnootaa dabalatee bu'uuraalee misoomaa siviilotaa mancaasuu isaa agarsiisuun kan of boonee fi gammachuu ibsate ture. Himannaa cimaa kana hunda ta'us, mootummaan Neezarlaand yeroo inni biyyattii keessa turetti tarkaanfii tokko illee irratti akka hin fudhanne dhaabbatichi gabaaseera.

title: Projectile damages engine room of tanker off Oman, UKMTO says
english: A tanker ship was hit by an unidentified projectile near the coast of Oman, causing significant damage to its engine room and leaving the vessel unable to move. Authorities confirmed that there were no injuries to the crew and no pollution resulting from the incident. Maritime officials have alerted the regional coast guard and issued a safety warning to other ships traveling in the area.
amharic: የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በማይታወቅ መሳሪያ በመመታቷ የሞተር ክፍሏ ጉዳት ደርሶባታል፤ በዚህም ሳቢያ መርከቧ መንቀሳቀስ ተስኗታል። ባለስልጣናት በሰው ህይወት ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳትም ሆነ የአካባቢ ብክለት እንደሌለ አረጋግጠዋል። የባህር ላይ ደህንነት ሃላፊዎች ለሌሎች በመርከብ ለሚጓዙ አካላት ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ማስጠንቀቂያ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Markabni boba'aa fe'u tokko qarqara galaana Omaanitti meeshaa waraanaa hin beekamneen rukutamee, kutaansaa kan injinii miidhamuun socho'uu akka hin dandeenye ta'eera. Abbootiin taayitaa miidhaan namarra ga'e ykn naannoo irratti rakkoon akka hin uumamne mirkaneessaniiru. Qondaalonni nageenya galaanaa, markaboota naannicha keessa darban hundaaf of eeggannoo guddaa akka taasisan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Iran will further tighten Hormuz if US naval blockade continues, top official says
english: A senior Iranian security official has threatened to restrict access to the Strait of Hormuz if the United States maintains its current naval blockade on Iranian ports. The official warned that such an escalation would negatively impact global energy markets and the American economy. Meanwhile, Iran is working with Oman to coordinate maritime traffic and has cautioned other countries against interfering with these efforts.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ባለስልጣን አሜሪካ በኢራን ወደቦች ላይ የምታደርገውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ የምትቀጥል ከሆነ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ የሚደረገውን እንቅስቃሴ እንደምትገድብ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ባለስልጣኑ ይህ ድርጊት በአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ገበያ እና በአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስ ገልጸዋል። በተያያዘም ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ያለውን የባህር ትራፊክ ለመቆጣጠር ከኦማን ጋር እየሰራች መሆኑን እና ሶስተኛ ወገኖች ጣልቃ እንዳይገቡ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iran, yoo Ameerikaan gabaa markaboota ishee irratti kan godhamaa jiru jabeessitee itti fufte, karaa bishaan Hormuz cufuuf akka dirqamtan akeekkachiisaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun gabaa anniisaa addunyaa fi diinagdee Ameerikaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Gama biraatiin, Iran karaa Hormuz keessa kan darbuu markaboota to'achuuf biyya Omaan waliin hojjechaa kan jirtu yoo ta'u, biyyoonni sadaffaan dhimma kana keessa akka hin galle akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Trump says Rubio’s anti-ICC campaign intended to shield Netanyahu
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that Secretary of State Marco Rubio is actively working against the International Criminal Court to protect Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Rubio described the court as illegitimate and stated the U.S. is launching a formal initiative to dismantle its influence. This move comes as the ICC maintains its authority to prosecute war crimes, even against nations that are not official members.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በአለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ላይ የሚወስዱት እርምጃ የእስራኤሉን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ለመከላከል እንደሆነ አረጋግጠዋል። ሩቢዮ ፍርድ ቤቱ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን በመግለጽ አሜሪካ በድርጅቱ ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ማቀዷን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የፍርድ ቤቱ የጦር ወንጀሎችን የመመርመር ስልጣን በግጭት ውስጥ ባሉ ሀገራት ላይም ተፈጻሚ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ከሚገልጸው አቋም ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Traamp akka jedhanitti, ministirri dhimma alaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoon mana murtii yakka addunyaa (ICC) irratti duula gaggeessaa jiran kun muummicha ministeera Israa'el Benyaamiin Netanyaahuu ittisuuf kan karoorfame dha. Ruubiyoon mana murtichaa akka dhaabbata seeraan alaa ta'etti kan ibsan yoo ta'u, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa mana murtichaa balleessuuf tarkaanfii fudhachuu jalqabuu ishee beeksisaniiru. Kunis ta'e, ICCn yakka waraanaa irratti abbaa seeraa ta'ee itti fufuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaa waliin wal qabata.

title: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on central Gaza
english: Israeli military operations across Gaza resulted in the deaths of two individuals and several injuries following drone strikes in Deir al-Balah. Additional attacks were reported across various parts of the Gaza Strip, including near hospitals and refugee camps. Meanwhile, Israeli forces arrested 13 people during security operations in the occupied West Bank.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ የድሮን ጥቃቶች ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቶቹ በዴር አል-ባላህ ከተማ እና በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች በሆስፒታሎች እና በስደተኞች መጠለያዎች አቅራቢያ ተካሂደዋል። በሌላ በኩል የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባካሄዱት ዘመቻ 13 ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel gara Gazaatti dhukaasa droomiin gaggeesseen namoonni lama ajjeefamanii kan biroon hedduun miidhaniiru. Haleellaan kun magaala Deir al-Balah dabalatee iddoowwan garaagaraa kanneen akka hospitaalotaa fi qubannaa baqattootaa irratti raawwatameera. Gama biraan, humni waraana Israa'eel naannoo West Bank keessatti namoota 13 to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Israel launches attacks across Gaza one day after Hamas agrees to disarm
english: Israel conducted air strikes throughout Gaza, resulting in at least two deaths and several injuries. This military action occurred shortly after Hamas accepted a US-backed peace proposal to disarm in stages. The failed agreement was intended to facilitate an Israeli military withdrawal from the region.

Waliigalteen kun Israa'el ganda Gaazaa irraa akka baatuuf kan karoorfame ture.

title: Trump administration to dismiss Reflecting Pool charges against David Hearn
english: The Trump administration has officially dropped criminal charges against Olympic athlete David Hearn, who was previously accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro admitted that the damage was caused by a faulty construction job rather than misconduct by Hearn. The prosecutor explained that the issues stemmed from rushed renovation work intended to meet a deadline for the nation's 250th anniversary celebration.

Rakkoon kun kan uumame ayyaana waggaa 250ffaa biyyattii qopheeysuuf hojiin ijaarsaa ariitiin raawwatamuu isaan akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Iran war live: Trump threatens strikes, Iran says it has a plan to respond
english: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated as President Trump threatens significant military strikes against the country. In response, Iranian officials have stated they have a strategic plan ready to retaliate against key American and Israeli infrastructure if they are attacked. Despite the heated rhetoric from both sides, there are also conflicting reports suggesting the proposed military action might still be canceled.

oromo: Prezidaant Traamp Iraan irratti haleellaa cimaa akka raawwatan waan doorsisaniif, walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran hammaateera. Haata'u malee, dubbiin kun hammaatus, tarkaanfiin waraanaa karoorfame kun haqamuu akka danda'u gabaasni tokko tokko ni agarsiisu.

title: FIFA’s Infantino scraps controversial World Cup private investment plan
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has canceled a controversial plan to sell a 20 percent stake in its events business after facing strong opposition from member associations. The proposal, which aimed to raise over $4 billion, was heavily criticized by UEFA, leading to threats of a boycott and the resignation of a key advisor. Due to the deep divisions and intense backlash, Infantino officially abandoned the project to maintain the unity of the sport.

oromo: Pireezidaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiinoo qooda daldala FIFA irraa dhibbeentaa 20 gurguruuf karoorfamee ture, mormii cimaa miseensota isaa irraa dhufeen walqabatee haqeera. Infantiinoo, walitti buiinsa fi mormii uumame kana booda, gamtaan ispoortichaa akka hin diigamneef jecha karooricha guutummaatti dhaabuuf murteesseera.

title: Analyst: the US faces a strategic ‘dead end’ in Iran
english: A former US congressional analyst warns that Washington is trapped in a strategic stalemate regarding Iran. The expert suggests that the U.S. is left with two difficult choices: either ramp up its military involvement or concede that Iran will maintain control over the Strait of Hormuz. This situation highlights the limited options currently available to American policymakers in the region.

Haalli kun karoora siyaasaa Ameerikaan naannichatti qabdu akka daangeffame agarsiisa.

title: Yemeni forces say eight Saudi tankers forced to reroute
english: Yemeni military officials announced that they successfully compelled eight Saudi oil tankers to change their travel routes away from the region. A spokesperson stated that these vessels were forced to redirect toward the Cape of Good Hope to avoid the ongoing blockade. Yemeni forces further warned that they plan to continue targeting Saudi shipping vessels whenever the opportunity arises.

Humnoonni Yaman kana boodas dooniiwwan Saudii irratti yeroo argame hundatti haleellaa kan raawwatan ta'uu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Araghchi says US actions ‘main causes’ of regional insecurity
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi recently accused the United States of being the primary source of regional instability during a discussion with his Indian counterpart. He cited American military actions, naval blockades, and attacks on commercial vessels as major threats to the Strait of Hormuz. In response, India's foreign minister emphasized the importance of utilizing diplomacy and peaceful dialogue to resolve these tensions.

Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Hindii gama isaaniin, rakkoolee kana hiikuuf karaa nagaa fi mariin deemuun murteessaa ta'uu cimsuun ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia calls Trump's Gaza 'demilitarisation deal' historic
english: Saudi Arabia has formally supported President Trump’s new agreement to demilitarize the Gaza Strip, highlighting the collaborative efforts of international partners. The kingdom emphasized that this deal must include a full Israeli withdrawal, the entry of humanitarian aid, and the return of the Palestinian Authority to govern the region. Ultimately, Saudi officials hope this process will serve as a foundation for achieving a permanent peace and the establishment of an independent Palestinian state.

Sa’udi Arabiyaan tarkaanfiin kun nagaa waaraa buusuufi biyya Paalastayinii kan bilisa taate ijaaruuf bu’uura ta’a jettee amanti.

title: Houthis say transit through Bab el-Mandeb free of charge
english: Yemen's Houthi group has officially denied rumors that they are charging fees for ships passing through the Bab el-Mandeb strait. They clarified that their transit services remain completely free and voluntary for eligible vessels. Additionally, they warned shipping companies not to pay any unauthorized individuals claiming to represent them.
amharic: የየመኑ የሁቲ ቡድን በባብ ኤል-ማንደብ ባህረ ሰላጤ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ክፍያ እንዲከፍሉ መደረጉን የሚገልጸውን ወሬ አስተባብለዋል። ቡድኑ ለመርከቦች የሚሰጠው የጉዞ አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ በነጻ እና በፈቃደኝነት ላይ የተመሰረተ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። እንዲሁም የመርከብ ኩባንያዎች ከቡድኑ ስም እየተጠቀሙ ክፍያ የሚጠይቁ አካላት እንዳይታለሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Gareen Huutii Yemen, markeewwan dhangala'aa Bab el-Mandeb keessa darban irraa kaffaltii fudhachaa jiraachuu isaanii gabaasame haaleera. Tajaajilli darbiinsaa kun kan bilisaa fi fedhii irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu ibsaniiru. Dabalataanis, maqaa isaaniitiin kaffaltii gaafatan yoo jiraatan qabeenya akka hin kennineef dhaabbilee doonii akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Palestinian authorities secure court order freezing demolitions in Jordan Valley
english: Palestinian officials have successfully secured a court injunction to temporarily halt the planned destruction of homes and barns in the northern Jordan Valley. This legal action follows earlier notices from Israeli authorities to demolish several Palestinian-owned buildings in the Al-Farisiya area. The stay of execution provides a reprieve for residents facing the loss of their property and livestock facilities.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት በዮርዳኖስ ሸለቆ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የታቀዱ የመኖሪያ ቤቶች እና የእርሻ መጋዘኖች መፍረስን እንዲያቆም የሚያስችል የፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ አግኝተዋል። ይህ ህጋዊ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በአል-ፋሪሲያ አካባቢ የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤቶችን ለማፍረስ ካሳወቁ በኋላ ነው። ይህ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ንብረታቸውን ለማጣት ተቃርበው የነበሩ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎችን ጊዜያዊ እፎይታ ሰጥቷል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Falasxiin naannoo Sulula Yordaanos kaabaatti manneen jireenyaa fi bakkeewwan horii diiguuf karoorfame dhaabsiisuuf ajaja mana murtii argataniiru. Tarkaanfii seeraa kana kan fudhatan, aangootni Israa'el naannoo Al-Faarisiyaatti manneen Falasxiinotaa diiguuf beeksisni ergame booda dha. Ajajni mana murtii kun namoota qabeenya isaanii dhabuuf jedhan irratti yeroof tasgabbii uumeera.

title: Kpler says Hormuz traffic drops sharply, remains steady through Bab el-Mandeb
english: Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has experienced a significant decline, dropping by 77 percent in a single day. In contrast, activity in the Bab el-Mandeb strait remains stable despite ongoing regional tensions and security concerns. Analysts suggest that shipping companies are becoming more cautious and are closely watching diplomatic developments that could impact the safety of these critical maritime routes.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ቁጥር በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ በ77 በመቶ ቀንሷል። በሌላ በኩል በባብ ኤል-ማንደብ የባህር መስመር ላይ ያለው የትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ውጥረቶች ቢኖሩም የተረጋጋ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል። የባህር ትራንስፖርት ኩባንያዎች አሁን ባለው የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ምክንያት ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ለደህንነታቸው የሚያሰጉ ክስተቶችን በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hojiin doonii gara galana Hormuz darban guyyaa tokko keessatti dhibbeentaa 77n hir’ateera. Gama biraatiin, naannoo Bab el-Mandeb kan darban dooniiwwan lakkoofsi isaanii tasgabbaa’aa dha. Dhaabbileen geejjiba galaanaa naannichatti haala jiruuf of eeggannoo guddaa gochaa jiru akkasumas gara fuulduraatti rakkoo uumamuu danda’u hordofaa jiru.

title: Trump threatens to hit Iran 'very hard'
english: President Donald Trump has warned of severe upcoming strikes against Iran to pressure the country into changing its behavior. Reports suggest the United States may coordinate with Israel to target Iranian oil refineries and power plants. These military actions could potentially commence as early as this weekend.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን ባህሪዋን እንድትቀይር ለማድረግ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ጠንካራ ጥቃቶችን እንደሚፈጽሙ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ዘገባዎች እንደሚያሳዩት አሜሪካ ከእስራኤል ጋር በመተባበር የኢራንን የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች እና የኃይል ማመንጫዎች ኢላማ ለማድረግ እያቀደች ነው። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች በዚህ ሳምንት መጨረሻ ሊጀመሩ እንደሚችሉ ይነገራል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Traamp Iran gocha ishee akka jijjiirtu dhiibbaa gochuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf akka jiran akeekkachiisaniiru. Gabaasoonni akka mul'isanitti, Ameerikaan Israa'el waliin ta'uun buufataalee qulqullina boba'aa fi buufataalee humna elektiriikii Iran miidhuuf karoorfataa jirti. Tarkaanfiin waraanaa kun torban dhumaa kana keessa jalqabamuu danda'a.

title: The 'Board of Peace' announced a Palestinian body will take Hamas weapons. That's not what Trump said
english: President Donald Trump stated that the 'Board of Peace' would handle the collection of weapons from Hamas. However, the organization itself clarified that a Palestinian technocratic body known as the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza will oversee this process. This creates a notable discrepancy between the president's claims and the official plan released by the board he leads.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሃማስን መሳሪያዎች በቁጥጥር ስር የሚያውለው 'የሰላም ቦርድ' እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ድርጅቱ በበኩሉ ይህንን ተግባር የሚያከናውነው የፍልስጤም የቴክኖክራቲክ አካል የሆነው የጋዛ አስተዳደር ብሔራዊ ኮሚቴ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ይህ የፕሬዝዳንቱ መግለጫ ቦርዱ ካወጣው ይፋዊ እቅድ ጋር ግጭት እንዳለው ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Doonaaldi Tiraamp akka jedhanitti qaamni 'Board of Peace' jedhamu meeshaalee waraanaa Hamaas harka fudhata. Haata'u malee, dhaabbatichi ofii isaa ibsa baaseen hojiin kun qaama teknokiraatawaa kan Falisxiin kan ta'e 'National Committee for the Administration of Gaza' tiin akka raawwatamu beeksisaniiru. Kunis ibsa pirezedaantichaa fi karoora dhaabbatichi ifa godhe gidduutti wal dhabbiin jiraachuu isaa mul'isa.

title: Israeli settlers vandalise Palestinian cemetery in West Bank
english: Israeli settlers damaged a Palestinian cemetery by destroying headstones during a march near the village of Tal in the occupied West Bank. Local residents reported that Israeli military forces escorted the group and used tear gas against Palestinians during the incident. This act of vandalism has caused significant distress in the local community.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ታልክ መንደር አቅራቢያ በተደረገ ሰልፍ ወቅት የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች የፍልስጤም መቃብርን በማውደም የመቃብር ድንጋዮችን ሰባብረዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደገለጹት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰልፈኞቹን በመታጀብ በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የለቅሶ ጋዝ ተጠቅመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Godina waldhiyaa (West Bank) ganda Ta’al jedhamu biratti, qubattoonni Israa’el hiriira ba’anii turan iddoo awwaalaa Palastineelotaa mancaasaniiru. Jiraattonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni Israa’el hiriira kana eeguun albee gubaa (tear gas) Palastineelota irratti darbachuun isaanii himameera. Gochi mancaatii kun hawaasa naannichaa keessatti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: US Senate’s Fauci hearing renews COVID origin debate but reveals little
english: A recent US Senate hearing involving former pandemic advisor Anthony Fauci failed to provide new insights into the origins of COVID-19. Instead, the session highlighted ongoing political disagreements, with Republican lawmakers continuing to argue that the virus leaked from a Chinese laboratory. Experts noted that these repeated investigations have not advanced scientific understanding but have intensified partisan hostility.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜው የአሜሪካ ሴኔት ችሎት ስለ ኮቪድ-19 መነሻ ምንነት አዲስ መረጃ ማምጣት አልቻለም። በምርመራው ወቅት የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ቫይረሱ ከቻይና ላብራቶሪ የወጣ መሆኑን በመከራከር በጉዳዩ ላይ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ልዩነት አሳይተዋል። ባለሙያዎች እንደገለጹት ይህ በተደጋጋሚ የሚካሄድ ክርክር ሳይንሳዊ እውነታን ከመፈለግ ይልቅ የፖለቲካ ክፍፍልን የሚያባብስ ነው።
oromo: Waltajjii seeneetiin biyya Ameerikaa keessatti gaggeeffame kan Dr. Anthony Fauci hirmaachise, waa'ee jalqaba vaayirasii COVID-19 irratti ragaa haaraa tokko illee hin fidne. Kutaaleen siyaasaa garaagaraa yaada wal-faallessuun irratti mari'atanis, miseensonni paartii Ripaabilikanii vaayirasichi laaboraatorii Chaayinaa keessaa akka ba'e amanuu isaanii itti fufaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, falmiin kun jijjiirama saayinsawaa fiduu mannaa, wal-qoodinsa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti gadi fageesseera.

title: Pathirage beats Chopra and Nadeem to win Commonwealth gold in javelin
english: Sri Lankan athlete Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage made history by winning his country's first-ever Commonwealth Games gold medal in the javelin throw. He outperformed top competitors including Neeraj Chopra, who secured the silver medal, while defending champion Arshad Nadeem was eliminated early. The 23-year-old former cricketer achieved his winning distance of 89.75 meters despite difficult weather conditions in Glasgow.
amharic: የስሪ ላንካው አትሌት ሩሜሽ ታራንጋ ፓቲራጌ በጦር ውርወራ ውድድር የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ በማግኘት ለሀገሩ የመጀመሪያውን የኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች የወርቅ ሜዳሊያ ታሪክ አስመዝግቧል። ፓቲራጌ የብር ሜዳሊያውን ያገኘውን ኒራጅ ቾፕራን በመብለጥ ድል የቀናው ሲሆን፣ የውድድሩ ተጠባቂ የነበረው አርሻድ ናዴም ቀደም ብሎ ከውድድሩ ወጥቷል። የቀድሞ የክሪኬት ተጫዋች የሆነው የ23 ዓመቱ አትሌት፣ በግላስጎው በተካሄደው አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ ውስጥ 89.75 ሜትር በመወርወር አሸናፊ ሆኗል።
oromo: Atileetiin biyya Sri Lanka Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage dargaa foonii (javelin) irratti injifannoo argachuun biyya isaaaf medaliyaa warqee jalqabaa seenaa tapha Commonwealth galchuu danda'eera. Pathirage dorgomtoota cimaa kan akka Neeraj Chopra (medaliyaa meetii argate) injifachuun yoo milkaa'u, dorgomaan cimaan Arshad Nadeem immoo sadarkaa jalqabaarratti mo'amee ba'eera. Umuriin isaa waggaa 23 kan ta'e fi kanaan dura taphataa kriket ture kun, haala qilleensa Glasgow kan rakkisaa ta'e keessatti fageenya meetira 89.75 fageessuun injifannoo argateera.

title: Children face higher threat of US deportation as legal support deal expires
english: A federal contract providing legal services to approximately 24,000 unaccompanied migrant children in the United States has expired, leaving their future representation uncertain. Advocates fear this gap will make these minors significantly more vulnerable to deportation under the current administration's strict immigration policies. The government has yet to announce a successor program or clarify how these children will receive the legal support they require.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ያለ አጃቢ ለሚገኙ ወደ 24,000 የሚጠጉ ህፃናት የህግ አገልግሎት ሲሰጥ የነበረው የፌደራል ውል መጠናቀቁ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ይህ ሁኔታ ህፃናቱ በስደት ላይ ባለው የአሜሪካ መንግስት ጥብቅ የኢሚግሬሽን ህግ መሰረት የመባረር እድላቸውን ከፍ እንደሚያደርገው የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች አስታውቀዋል። መንግስት ተተኪ ፕሮግራም ይፋ ያላደረገ ሲሆን፣ ህፃናቱ ወደፊት የህግ ድጋፍ እንዴት እንደሚያገኙ ግልጽ አልሆነም።
oromo: USA keessatti ijoollee gargaarsa nama biraa malee godaanan gara 24,000 ta’aniif tajaajila seeraa kennaa ture tokko xumuramuu isaatiin walqabatee rakkoon uumameera. Gargaartonni mirga namoomaa akka jedhanitti, dhabamuun gargaarsa kanaa ijoolleen kunneen dhiibbaa siyaasa immigreeshinii mootummaa ammaa jala oolanii akka ari’aman sodaachiseera. Mootummaan hanga ammaatti bakka buutuuf karoorri ifatti waan hin baaneef, ijoolleen kunneen gara fuulduraatti akkamitti deeggarsa seeraa akka argatan ifa miti.

title: Iran says ready to target Israeli, US infrastructure in response to potential ‘American recklessness’
english: A high-ranking Iranian security official announced that the country has developed a strategy to retaliate against any aggressive actions from the United States. Should Washington or its allies initiate attacks, Iran intends to strike essential facilities, including energy networks, within Israel and the broader region. This warning comes as a direct response to concerns regarding potential Western military aggression.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ባለሥልጣን አገራቸው በአሜሪካ በኩል የሚመጣን ማንኛውንም ጥቃት ለመመከት የሚያስችል ዝግጅት ማድረጓን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ወይም አጋሮቿ ጥቃት ቢሰነዝሩ ኢራን በእስራኤል እና በአካባቢው በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የአጸፋ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ማቀዷን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው ሊፈጸም ይችላል ተብሎ በሚሰጋው የምዕራባውያን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenyaa Iran akka ibsanitti, biyyattiin tarkaanfii waraanaa Ameerikaa irraa isheen dhufu kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf qophiin ishee xumuruu beeksisaniiru. Yoo Ameerikaan ykn biyyoonni ishee deggeran miidhaa geessisan, Iran bu'uuraalee misoomaa Israa'el fi dhaabbilee anniisaa Ameerikaa naannichatti argaman irratti tarkaanfii deebii kennuuf karoorfateetti. Akeekkachiisni kun kan kenname sodaa miidhaa waraanaa lixaan biyyootaa irraa ishee qunnamuu danda'u ilaalchisee dha.

title: UK, UAE discuss situation in the Middle East, Strait of Hormuz
english: British official Ed Miliband met with UAE Deputy Prime Minister Abdullah bin Zayed to address regional instability in the Middle East. The two leaders emphasized the importance of ensuring safe and uninterrupted maritime travel through the Strait of Hormuz. Furthermore, they pledged to strengthen the bilateral relationship between the UK and the UAE to foster mutual economic success.
amharic: የብሪታንያው ባለስልጣን ኤድ ሚሊባንድ ከተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ምክትል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አብዱላህ ቢን ዘይድ ጋር በመገናኘት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ስላለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ መክረዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር ላይ ጉዞ ደህንነትንና ነፃነትን ማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። በተጨማሪም በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት እና የጋራ ብልጽግና ለማጠናከር ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyyoota UK fi UAE, kanneen akka Ed Miliband fi Abdullah bin Zayed, haala nageenyaa giddu galeessa bahaa irratti mari'ataniiru. Marii isaanii keessatti, bakka lafa Hormuz keessatti nageenyaa fi bilisummaan qaxxaamura galaanaa akka eegamu irratti xiyyeeffataniiru. Kana malees, gamtaan kun guddina diinagdee fi bu'aa waloo biyyoota lamaanii mirkaneessuuf walitti dhufeenya isaanii cimsuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Columbia University student workers’ union withdraws Israel divestment demand
english: The student workers' union at Columbia University has decided to drop its formal demand for the school to divest from Israel. This choice was made by the organization's members during a recent meeting regarding their contract negotiations. By removing this article, the group is no longer pushing for the university to disclose all its financial holdings or divest from companies based on international law violations.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተማሪዎች ሠራተኛ ማህበር ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከእስራኤል ጋር ያለውን የገንዘብ ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጥ ያቀርብ የነበረውን ጥያቄ ሰርዟል። ማህበሩ ይህንን ውሳኔ የወሰነው በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የውል ድርድር ወቅት በአባላቱ ድምፅ ነው። በዚህም መሰረት ማህበሩ ዩኒቨርሲቲው የገንዘብ ዝርዝሩን እንዲያሳውቅ እና በአለም አቀፍ ህግ ጥሰት ላይ ተመስርተው ኢንቨስትመንቶችን እንዲያቆም ሲጠይቅ የነበረውን አንቀፅ ከስምምነቱ ውጭ አድርጓል።
oromo: Tokkummaan hojjettoota barattoota Yuunivarsiitii Kolombiyaa, yuunivarsiitiin sun Israa'el keessaa maallaqa isaa akka baasu gaafachaa ture haquu isaa beeksiseera. Murtoon kun kan darbe yeroo marii waliigaltee kaffaltii fi hojii irratti miseensonni tokkummaa kun sagalee kennaniin dha. Kanaafuu, tokkummaan kun ammayyuu yuunivarsiitiin qabeenya isaa akka ifa godhu ykn seera idil-addunyaa cabsuudhaan himatamanii kanneen irratti invastmentii akka dhaabu gaaffii dhiyeessaa ture dhiiseera.

title: US Centcom says ’30 commerical vessels’ redirected during Iran blockade
english: The US Central Command reported that it has managed maritime traffic amidst an Iranian blockade by redirecting 30 commercial ships and stopping two others for compliance inspections. Additionally, the military successfully facilitated the passage of nearly 30 vessels carrying humanitarian aid. These actions were taken to maintain safe navigation and ensure that essential supplies reach their destinations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም በአሁኑ ወቅት እየተካሄደ ባለው የኢራን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ሳቢያ 30 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ ማስቀየሩን እና ሁለት መርከቦችንም ለቁጥጥር ማቆሙን አስታውቋል። በተጨማሪም ወታደራዊው ክፍል ለሰብአዊ እርዳታ የተጫኑ ወደ 30 የሚጠጉ መርከቦች በደህና እንዲያልፉ ፈቅዷል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች የባህር ላይ ጉዞን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እና እርዳታ ለሚፈልጉ ሰዎች በፍጥነት እንዲደርስ ለማድረግ የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Ajajni Giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) duula uggura galaanaa kan Iraan taasiftuun wal-qabatee, markaboota daldalaa 30 gara karaa biraatti akka geesseefi markaboota lama ammoo qorannoodhaaf akka dhaabde ibseera. Kana malees, waraanni kun markaboota gargaarsa namoomaa fe'an kanneen 30 ta'an karaa nageenyaan akka darban hayyamera. Tarkaanfiiwwan kun kan fudhataman nagaa karaa galaanaa eeguufi gargaarsi barbaachisu bakka ga'uuf akka danda'uufi.

title: Cambridge students on why they protested at graduation ceremony
english: Several students at Cambridge University staged protests during their graduation ceremonies to express their opposition to the institution's financial ties to Israel. The students were motivated by reports that the university's large endowment fund contains nearly $189 million invested in companies linked to the Israeli state. By choosing this significant event to voice their concerns, the protesters aimed to draw attention to the university's investment policies.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተማሪዎች ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከእስራኤል ጋር ባለው የገንዘብ ግንኙነት በመቃወም በምረቃ ስነ-ስርዓታቸው ላይ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ተማሪዎቹ ይህን እርምጃ የወሰዱት የዩኒቨርሲቲው የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ፈንድ ከ189 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ከእስራኤል ጋር በተያያዙ ድርጅቶች ላይ ኢንቨስት መደረጉን በመቃወም ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የምረቃ ቀናቸውን እንደ መድረክ በመጠቀም የዩኒቨርሲቲውን የኢንቨስትመንት ፖሊሲ በአደባባይ እንዲወያዩበት አድርገዋል።
oromo: Barattoonni Yuunivarsitii Kaambiriijii tokko tokko, yuunivarsitiin isaanii Israa'elii wajjin hariiroo maallaqaa qabaachuu isaatiin mormii dhageessisaniiru. Barattoonni kun kanneen mormii kana kaasanii, qabeenyi yuunivarsitichaa miiliyoona 189 dolaaraa ta'u dhaabbilee Israa'elii wajjin hariiroo qaban keessatti kasaaraa jiraachuu isaatiin akka ta'e ibsameera. Barattoonni kun guyyaa eebba isaanii akka carraa tokkootti fayyadamuun, siyaasa invastimantii yuunivarsitichaa mormuu isaanii beeksisaniiru.
